source.text: ה֥וֹי הַחֹֽקְקִ֖ים חִקְקֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּֽמְכַתְּבִ֥ים עָמָ֖ל כִּתֵּֽבוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe, those decreeing decrees of wickedness, and writers [of] trouble [who] write,

en.L: Woe, those who decree decrees of wickedness, \q and writers [who] write trouble,
en.B: Woe to those who make wicked statutes, \q and to the scribes who keep writing out misery,
en.R: How terrible it will be for those who make evil laws, \q for the officials who write rules that bring people trouble!

es.L: ¡Ay de los que decretan decretos de maldad, \q y de los escribas [que] escriben opresión,
es.B: ¡Ay de los que dictan leyes injustas, \q y de los escribas que no dejan de escribir desgracias,
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para los que hacen leyes malvadas, \q para los funcionarios que escriben normas que causan sufrimiento a la gente!

fr.L: Malheur, ceux qui décrètent des décrets d’iniquité, \q et les écrivains [qui] écrivent l’oppression,
fr.B: Malheur à ceux qui établissent des lois injustes, \q et aux scribes qui rédigent sans cesse la misère,
fr.R: Quel malheur pour ceux qui font des lois mauvaises, \q pour les fonctionnaires qui écrivent des règles qui causent du malheur aux gens !

sw.L: Ole, wale wanaoamuru amri za uovu, \q na waandishi [wanaoandika] taabu,
sw.B: Ole wao wanaotunga sheria za uovu, \q na waandishi wanaoendelea kuandika dhuluma,
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa wale wanaotunga sheria mbaya, \q na kwa maafisa wanaoandika kanuni zinazowaletea watu taabu!

vi.L: Khốn cho những kẻ ban hành luật lệ gian ác, \q và những kẻ viết ra điều áp bức,
vi.B: Khốn cho những kẻ đặt ra luật lệ bất công, \q và những kẻ cứ viết ra những điều gây khổ cực,
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho những kẻ đặt ra luật lệ gian ác, \q cho những viên chức viết ra luật lệ gây khốn khổ cho người ta!

decisions.choice: woe: the last of a series of woes
decisions.reason: The cry of grief and warning takes up the woes of 5:8-23. This one is aimed at those who use the law itself to rob the weak.

decisions.choice: write trouble: put oppression into writing
decisions.reason: The word means toil, trouble or misery. The scribes write documents and rulings that bring hardship on others, so the harm is done with the authority of written law. The verb form suggests they keep on doing it.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verse 2
decisions.reason: Verse 2 says what these laws are for, so the record ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: officials who write rules
decisions.reason: The writers are those who draft legal rulings for the court; Readable names them as officials.

source.text: לְהַטּ֤וֹת מִדִּין֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְלִגְזֹ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיֵּ֣י עַמִּ֑י לִהְי֤וֹת אַלְמָנוֹת֙ שְׁלָלָ֔ם וְאֶת־יְתוֹמִ֖ים יָבֹֽזּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: to turn aside from judgment [the] poor and to take away [the] justice of [the] poor of my people, to be widows their prey, and the fatherless they plunder.

en.L: to turn aside the poor from judgment \q and to rob the afflicted of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people [of their] justice, \q that widows may be their prey \q and [that] they may plunder the fatherless.
en.B: to push the needy away from a fair hearing \q and strip the poor among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people of their rights, \q so that widows become their spoil \q and orphans their loot.
en.R: They keep poor people from getting a fair trial. \q They take away the rights of the needy among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. \q They rob widows and steal from children who have no father.

es.L: para apartar del juicio a los pobres \q y para robar [su] derecho a los afligidos de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q para que las viudas sean su presa \q y [para que] despojen a los huérfanos!
es.B: para negar a los necesitados una audiencia justa \q y quitar sus derechos a los pobres de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q para que las viudas sean su botín \q y los huérfanos su presa!
es.R: No dejan que los pobres tengan un juicio justo. \q Les quitan los derechos a los necesitados de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. \q Roban a las viudas y les quitan sus cosas a los niños que no tienen padre.

fr.L: pour détourner du jugement les pauvres \q et ravir leur droit aux humbles de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q pour que les veuves soient leur proie \q et [qu’]ils pillent les orphelins.
fr.B: pour écarter les indigents d’un procès équitable \q et dépouiller de leurs droits les pauvres de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q pour que les veuves deviennent leur butin \q et les orphelins leur proie.
fr.R: Ils empêchent les pauvres d’avoir un procès juste. \q Ils enlèvent leurs droits aux malheureux de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. \q Ils volent les veuves et dépouillent les enfants qui n’ont plus de père.

sw.L: ili kuwageuza maskini wasipate hukumu \q na kuwanyang'anya wanyonge wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} haki [yao], \q ili wajane wawe mawindo yao \q na [ili] wawateke yatima.
sw.B: ili kuwazuia wahitaji wasisikilizwe kwa haki \q na kuwanyang'anya maskini kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} haki zao, \q hata wajane wanakuwa nyara zao \q na yatima mawindo yao.
sw.R: Wanawazuia maskini wasipate hukumu ya haki. \q Wanawanyang'anya wahitaji kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} haki zao. \q Wanawaibia wajane na kuwanyang'anya watoto wasio na baba.

vi.L: để gạt người nghèo khỏi sự xét xử \q và cướp đoạt công lý của người khốn khổ trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q để người góa bụa thành mồi của chúng, \q và để chúng cướp bóc kẻ mồ côi.
vi.B: để xô đẩy người túng thiếu khỏi sự xét xử công bằng \q và tước đoạt quyền lợi của người nghèo khổ trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q để người góa bụa thành chiến lợi phẩm của chúng \q và trẻ mồ côi thành của cướp của chúng.
vi.R: Chúng không cho người nghèo được xét xử công bằng. \q Chúng tước đoạt quyền lợi của người túng thiếu trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng cướp của người góa bụa và lấy trộm của những đứa trẻ không cha.

decisions.choice: judgment, justice: a fair hearing and the rights it protects
decisions.reason: The first word is the legal case or verdict; the second is justice, a person's right before the law. The needy are turned away from the court, and their rights are taken from them.

decisions.choice: my people: the LORD speaking
decisions.reason: As in 3:12-15, the LORD calls the poor "my people". Those who rob them rob his own.

decisions.choice: widows and the fatherless: those with no man to defend them in court
decisions.reason: In Israel a widow or an orphan had no husband or father to speak for them at the gate, where cases were heard. The law put them under God's own care (Exodus 22:21-23; Deuteronomy 10:18), and Isaiah's first chapter called for justice for them (1:17, 23).

decisions.choice: They keep ... They take ... They rob
decisions.reason: Readable ends the sentence of verse 1 and states the purpose of the laws as what the lawmakers do.

source.text: וּמַֽה־תַּעֲשׂוּ֙ לְי֣וֹם פְּקֻדָּ֔ה וּלְשׁוֹאָ֖ה מִמֶּרְחָ֣ק תָּב֑וֹא עַל־מִי֙ תָּנ֣וּסוּ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה וְאָ֥נָה תַעַזְב֖וּ כְּבוֹדְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And what will you do for [the] day of punishment, and for the devastation [that] from far will come? To whom will you flee for help, and where will you leave your wealth?

en.L: And what will you do on [the] day of visitation, \q and in the devastation [that] will come from afar? \q To whom will you flee for help, \q and where will you leave your wealth?
en.B: What will you do on the day you are called to account, \q when ruin comes sweeping in from far away? \q Whom will you flee to for help? \q And where will you leave your wealth behind?
en.R: What will you do when the day comes for you to be punished? \q What will you do when disaster comes on you from a faraway land? \q Who will you run to for help? \q Where will you hide your riches?

es.L: ¿Y qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} en el día de la visitación, \q y en la devastación [que] vendrá de lejos? \q ¿A quién {{plural_you:huirán|huiréis}} en busca de ayuda, \q y dónde {{plural_you:dejarán su riqueza|dejaréis vuestra riqueza}}?
es.B: ¿Qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} el día en que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} que rendir cuentas, \q cuando la ruina llegue arrasando desde lejos? \q ¿A quién {{plural_you:acudirán|acudiréis}} en busca de ayuda? \q ¿Y dónde {{plural_you:dejarán su riqueza|dejaréis vuestra riqueza}}?
es.R: ¿Qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} cuando llegue el día de {{plural_you:su castigo|vuestro castigo}}? \q ¿Qué {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} cuando el desastre {{plural_you:les|os}} llegue de un país lejano? \q ¿A quién {{plural_you:correrán|correréis}} a pedir ayuda? \q ¿Dónde {{plural_you:esconderán sus riquezas|esconderéis vuestras riquezas}}?

fr.L: Et que ferez-vous au jour de la visite, \q et dans la dévastation [qui] viendra de loin ? \q Vers qui fuirez-vous pour [avoir] du secours, \q et où laisserez-vous votre richesse ?
fr.B: Que ferez-vous au jour où l’on vous demandera des comptes, \q quand la ruine arrivera de loin comme une tempête ? \q Vers qui fuirez-vous pour trouver du secours ? \q Et où laisserez-vous vos richesses ?
fr.R: Que ferez-vous quand viendra le jour où vous serez punis ? \q Que ferez-vous quand le malheur viendra sur vous d’un pays lointain ? \q Vers qui courrez-vous pour demander de l’aide ? \q Où cacherez-vous vos richesses ?

sw.L: Nanyi mtafanya nini katika siku ya kujiliwa, \q na katika uharibifu [utakaokuja] kutoka mbali? \q Mtamkimbilia nani awasaidie, \q na mtaiacha wapi mali yenu?
sw.B: Mtafanya nini siku mtakapoitwa kutoa hesabu, \q maangamizi yatakapowajia kutoka mbali? \q Mtamkimbilia nani awasaidie? \q Na mtaiacha wapi mali yenu?
sw.R: Mtafanya nini siku itakapofika ya kuadhibiwa kwenu? \q Mtafanya nini maafa yatakapowajia kutoka nchi ya mbali? \q Mtamkimbilia nani awasaidie? \q Mtaficha wapi mali zenu?

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ làm gì trong ngày thăm phạt, \q trong cơn tàn phá từ phương xa đến? \q Các ngươi sẽ chạy trốn đến ai để cầu cứu, \q và sẽ để của cải mình ở đâu?
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ làm gì trong ngày bị đòi tính sổ, \q khi tai họa ập đến từ phương xa? \q Các ngươi sẽ chạy đến ai mà cầu cứu? \q Các ngươi sẽ bỏ lại của cải mình ở đâu?
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ làm gì khi đến ngày các ngươi bị trừng phạt? \q Các ngươi sẽ làm gì khi tai họa từ một xứ xa xôi ập đến trên các ngươi? \q Các ngươi sẽ chạy đến ai để cầu cứu? \q Các ngươi sẽ giấu của cải mình ở đâu?

decisions.choice: day of visitation: the day God calls to account
decisions.reason: The word is from the verb "visit, attend to". When God visits wrongdoers, he calls them to account and punishes (the verb in verse 12). The day is a time of judgment.

decisions.choice: devastation: a storm of ruin
decisions.reason: The word means a sudden ruin, like a storm that lays waste. "From afar" points to an army from a distant land, the Assyrians of verse 5 (5:26).

decisions.choice: wealth: riches, often thought of as one's weight and honor
decisions.reason: The word for wealth comes from the root "be heavy", the root of "glory". The riches taken from the poor cannot be carried away or kept safe on that day.

decisions.choice: hide
decisions.reason: "Leave" means to leave in safekeeping; Readable says "hide" to make the point clear: there will be no safe place for it.

source.text: בִּלְתִּ֤י כָרַע֙ תַּ֣חַת אַסִּ֔יר וְתַ֥חַת הֲרוּגִ֖ים יִפֹּ֑לוּ בְּכָל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Except [one] crouches under prisoner[s], and under [the] slain they will fall. In all this not has turned back his anger, and still his hand [is] stretched out.

en.L: [Nothing remains] except [that one] crouches among [the] prisoners, \q and among [the] slain they fall. \q For all this {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger has not turned back, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand [is] still stretched out.
en.B: Nothing is left but to crouch down among the captives \q or to fall among the dead. \q Even so, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger has not turned back; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand is still stretched out.
en.R: All you will be able to do is kneel down with the prisoners \q or lie among the dead. \q Even after all this, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is still angry. \q His hand is still raised to strike.

es.L: [No queda] sino agacharse entre [los] prisioneros, \q y entre [los] muertos caen. \q Con todo esto no se ha apartado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, \q y todavía {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano [está] extendida.
es.B: No queda más que agacharse entre los cautivos \q o caer entre los muertos. \q A pesar de todo esto, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira no se ha apartado; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano sigue extendida.
es.R: Lo único que {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} hacer será arrodillarse con los prisioneros \q o quedar tendidos entre los muertos. \q Pero aun después de todo esto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sigue enojado. \q Todavía tiene la mano levantada para golpear.

fr.L: [Il ne reste] qu’à se courber parmi les prisonniers, \q et parmi les tués ils tomberont. \q Malgré tout cela, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ne s’est pas détournée, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main [est] encore étendue.
fr.B: Il ne reste qu’à se courber parmi les captifs \q ou à tomber parmi les morts. \q Malgré tout cela, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ne s’est pas détournée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main est toujours étendue.
fr.R: Tout ce que vous pourrez faire, c’est vous agenouiller avec les prisonniers \q ou tomber parmi les morts. \q Mais même après tout cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est toujours en colère. \q Sa main est encore levée pour frapper.

sw.L: [Hakuna kilichobaki] ila [mtu] kuinama kati ya wafungwa, \q na kati ya waliouawa wanaanguka. \q Kwa haya yote hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} haikugeuka, \q na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} bado [umenyoshwa].
sw.B: Hakuna kilichobaki ila kujikunyata kati ya mateka \q au kuanguka kati ya wafu. \q Pamoja na hayo yote, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} haijageuka; \q mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} bado umenyoshwa.
sw.R: Mtakachoweza kufanya tu ni kupiga magoti pamoja na wafungwa \q au kulala kati ya wafu. \q Hata baada ya hayo yote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} bado amekasirika. \q Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} bado umeinuliwa kupiga.

vi.L: [Chẳng còn gì] ngoài việc khom mình giữa đám tù nhân, \q và ngã giữa những kẻ bị giết. \q Dù vậy, cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn chưa nguôi, \q và tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn giơ ra.
vi.B: Chẳng còn gì ngoài việc cúi rạp giữa đám tù binh \q hay ngã gục giữa những xác chết. \q Dù vậy, cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn chưa nguôi; \q tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn giơ ra.
vi.R: Các ngươi chỉ còn có thể quỳ xuống giữa đám tù binh \q hay nằm giữa những người chết. \q Nhưng dù đã vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn còn giận. \q Tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn giơ lên để đánh phạt.

decisions.choice: except one crouches: there is no way out but captivity or death
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is very compressed: "except one crouches under prisoners, and under the slain they fall". It means that the only choices left are to bow down among the captives or to fall among the dead. "Under" may mean among them or beneath them, crushed under the heap.

decisions.choice: his anger has not turned back: the refrain of 5:25 and 9:11, 16, 20
decisions.reason: The same refrain closes each stanza of the poem that begins in 9:7 (Hebrew numbering) and goes back to 5:25. Here it closes the poem: the judgment is not over yet.

decisions.choice: the LORD is still angry
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD as the one whose anger has not turned back, and explains the stretched-out hand as a hand raised to strike.

source.text: ה֥וֹי אַשּׁ֖וּר שֵׁ֣בֶט אַפִּ֑י וּמַטֶּה־ה֥וּא בְיָדָ֖ם זַעְמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe, Assyria, [the] rod of my anger, and a staff it [is] in their hand, my indignation.

en.L: Woe, Assyria, [the] rod of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, \q and the staff in their hand [is] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} indignation!
en.B: Woe to Assyria, the rod of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger! \q The club they hold in their hand is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} indignation.
en.R: How terrible it will be for Assyria! I use Assyria like a stick to punish when I am angry. \q The club they swing is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fury.

es.L: ¡Ay de Asiria, vara de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, \q y el bastón en su mano [es] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} indignación!
es.B: ¡Ay de Asiria, la vara de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira! \q El garrote que tienen en la mano es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} indignación.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para Asiria! Uso a Asiria como un palo para castigar cuando estoy enojado. \q El garrote que ellos blanden es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furia.

fr.L: Malheur, Assyrie, verge de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, \q et le bâton dans leur main [est] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} indignation !
fr.B: Malheur à l’Assyrie, la verge de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère ! \q Le gourdin qu’ils tiennent en main, c’est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} indignation.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour l’Assyrie ! Je me sers de l’Assyrie comme d’un bâton pour punir quand je suis en colère. \q Le gourdin qu’ils brandissent, c’est {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur.

sw.L: Ole, Ashuru, fimbo ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q na gongo lililo mkononi mwao [ni] ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!
sw.B: Ole wake Ashuru, fimbo ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}! \q Rungu walilonalo mkononi ni ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa Ashuru! Ninamtumia Ashuru kama fimbo ya kuadhibu ninapokasirika. \q Rungu wanalolipiga ni ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Khốn cho A-si-ri, cây roi của cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q cây gậy trong tay chúng [là] cơn phẫn nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!
vi.B: Khốn cho A-si-ri, cây roi của cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! \q Cây gậy chúng cầm trong tay là cơn phẫn nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho A-si-ri! Ta dùng A-si-ri như cây roi để trừng phạt khi Ta nổi giận. \q Cây gậy chúng vung lên chính là cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: Assyria, the rod of my anger: the tool God uses to punish
decisions.reason: The woe now turns on Assyria itself. God calls it the rod he swings in his anger. The great empire is only a stick in his hand (verse 15); it will be punished in its turn for its pride (verse 12). The rod of verses 5, 15 and 24 returns in 14:5 and 30:31.

decisions.choice: a staff it is in their hand, my indignation: the staff they hold is God's fury
alternatives: a staff of my indignation is in their hand
decisions.reason: The second line is compressed. It most likely means that the club in the Assyrians' hand is God's own indignation at work. "Their" is the Assyrian people; in verse 6 the nation is spoken of as "him".

decisions.choice: I use Assyria like a stick to punish
decisions.reason: Readable unpacks the image of the rod into a sentence.

source.text: בְּג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ וְעַל־עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֔ז וּלְשׂוּמ֥וֹ מִרְמָ֖ס כְּחֹ֥מֶר חוּצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Against a nation godless I send him, and against [the] people of my wrath I command him, to plunder plunder and to take spoil spoil, and to make it a trampling like [the] mud of [the] streets.

en.L: Against a godless nation I send him, \q and against the people of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath I command him, \q to plunder plunder and to seize spoil, \q and to make it a trampled place like the mud of [the] streets.
en.B: I send him against a corrupt nation; \q against the people who stir {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath I give him orders, \q to carry off spoil and haul away plunder, \q and to stamp them into the ground like mud in the streets.
en.R: I send the Assyrians against a nation that does not respect {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I order them to attack the people who have made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry. \q I order them to carry off everything those people own and to stomp on them like mud in the street.

es.L: Contra una nación impía lo envío, \q y contra el pueblo de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor le doy orden, \q para saquear saqueo y arrebatar botín, \q y para convertirlo en algo pisoteado como el lodo de [las] calles.
es.B: Lo envío contra una nación corrompida; \q contra el pueblo que provoca {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor le doy órdenes, \q para que se lleve el botín y arrebate el despojo, \q y lo pisotee como el barro de las calles.
es.R: Envío a los asirios contra una nación que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} respeta. \q Les ordeno atacar al pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha hecho enojar. \q Les ordeno llevarse todo lo que esa gente tiene y pisotearla como el barro de la calle.

fr.L: Contre une nation impie je l’envoie, \q et contre le peuple de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} courroux je lui donne ordre, \q pour piller le pillage et pour saisir la dépouille, \q et pour en faire une chose piétinée comme la boue des rues.
fr.B: Je l’envoie contre une nation corrompue ; \q contre le peuple qui excite {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} courroux je lui donne mes ordres, \q pour emporter des dépouilles et rafler du butin, \q et pour le piétiner comme la boue des rues.
fr.R: J’envoie les Assyriens contre une nation qui ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} respecte pas. \q Je leur ordonne d’attaquer le peuple qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a mis en colère. \q Je leur ordonne d’emporter tout ce que ces gens possèdent et de les piétiner comme la boue de la rue.

sw.L: Juu ya taifa lisilomcha Mungu ninamtuma, \q na juu ya watu wa ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ninamwamuru, \q ateke mateka na kunyang'anya nyara, \q na kuwafanya wakanyagwe kama matope ya njiani.
sw.B: Ninamtuma dhidi ya taifa potovu; \q dhidi ya watu wanaochochea ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ninampa amri, \q achukue mateka na kubeba nyara, \q na kuwakanyaga chini kama matope ya njiani.
sw.R: Ninawatuma Waashuru dhidi ya taifa lisilonicha. \q Ninawaamuru wawashambulie watu walionikasirisha. \q Ninawaamuru wachukue kila kitu walicho nacho watu hao, na kuwakanyaga kama matope njiani.

vi.L: Ta sai nó đến nghịch cùng một dân tộc vô đạo, \q và Ta truyền lệnh cho nó nghịch cùng dân của cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q để cướp lấy của cướp và đoạt lấy chiến lợi phẩm, \q và giày đạp nó như bùn ngoài đường phố.
vi.B: Ta sai nó đi đánh một dân tộc vô đạo; \q Ta truyền lệnh cho nó nghịch lại dân đã khơi dậy cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q để cướp của và lấy chiến lợi phẩm, \q để giẫm đạp chúng như bùn ngoài đường.
vi.R: Ta sai quân A-si-ri đến đánh một dân tộc không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta ra lệnh cho chúng tấn công dân đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi giận. \q Ta ra lệnh cho chúng lấy hết của cải của dân ấy và giẫm đạp họ như bùn ngoài đường.

decisions.choice: godless: corrupt, without reverence for God
decisions.reason: The word describes someone who is defiled and has turned from God while still keeping up appearances (9:16, Hebrew numbering). The nation is God's own people, Judah and Israel ("the people of my wrath").

decisions.choice: to plunder plunder and to take spoil spoil: the name of Isaiah's son
decisions.reason: The same two words make up the name Maher-shalal-hash-baz, "Swift to the spoil, quick to the plunder" (8:1, 3). What that name foretold is now God's order to Assyria.

decisions.choice: to make it: the reading of the margin
decisions.reason: The written text and the reading in the margin differ only in the spelling of the verb "make"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: the Assyrians ... them
decisions.reason: "Him" is Assyria, spoken of as one person. Readable names the Assyrians and uses "them".

decisions.choice: saquear saqueo y arrebatar botín
decisions.reason: The words are those of the name Maher-salal-has-baz (8:1, 3); L keeps the two nouns "saqueo" and "botín" so the reader can hear the name's words again.

decisions.choice: "ateke mateka na kunyang'anya nyara"
decisions.reason: The doubled Hebrew phrase is the name of Isaiah's son (m2); Swahili keeps a verb with its own noun twice, though the name itself is not translated at 8:1.

decisions.choice: "piller le pillage ... saisir la dépouille"
decisions.reason: The two words are those of the name Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz (8:1, 3); Literal keeps the doubled noun and verb so the echo can be seen.

source.text: וְהוּא֙ לֹא־כֵ֣ן יְדַמֶּ֔ה וּלְבָב֖וֹ לֹא־כֵ֣ן יַחְשֹׁ֑ב כִּ֚י לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד בִּלְבָב֔וֹ וּלְהַכְרִ֥ית גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א מְעָֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And he not so intends, and his heart not so plans; for to destroy [is] in his heart, and to cut off nations not a few.

en.L: But he does not intend so, \q and his heart does not plan so; \q for to destroy [is] in his heart, \q and to cut off nations, not a few.
en.B: But that is not what he has in view; \q that is not the plan in his heart. \q What he has at heart is to wipe out and cut down nations, and not a few.
en.R: But the king of Assyria does not think of it this way. \q That is not what he plans. \q All he wants is to destroy many nations and wipe them out.

es.L: Pero él no lo piensa así, \q y su corazón no lo planea así; \q porque destruir [está] en su corazón, \q y cortar naciones, no pocas.
es.B: Pero eso no es lo que él tiene en mente; \q ese no es el plan de su corazón. \q Lo que lleva en el corazón es aniquilar y exterminar naciones, y no pocas.
es.R: Pero el rey de Asiria no lo ve de esa manera. \q Eso no es lo que él planea. \q Lo único que quiere es destruir a muchas naciones y acabar con ellas.

fr.L: Mais lui, il ne l’entend pas ainsi, \q et son cœur ne le pense pas ainsi ; \q car détruire [est] dans son cœur, \q et retrancher des nations, non en petit nombre.
fr.B: Mais ce n’est pas ce qu’il a en vue ; \q ce n’est pas le projet de son cœur. \q Ce qu’il a à cœur, c’est d’anéantir et d’abattre des nations, et pas qu’un peu.
fr.R: Mais le roi d’Assyrie ne voit pas les choses ainsi. \q Ce n’est pas ce qu’il a l’intention de faire. \q Tout ce qu’il veut, c’est détruire beaucoup de nations et les faire disparaître.

sw.L: Lakini yeye hakusudii hivyo, \q wala moyo wake haupangi hivyo; \q kwa maana kuangamiza [kumo] moyoni mwake, \q na kukatilia mbali mataifa, si machache.
sw.B: Lakini hilo silo analolikusudia; \q huo sio mpango ulio moyoni mwake. \q Analolitaka moyoni ni kufutilia mbali na kukatakata mataifa, tena si machache.
sw.R: Lakini mfalme wa Ashuru hafikiri hivyo. \q Hiyo siyo mipango yake. \q Anachotaka tu ni kuyaangamiza mataifa mengi na kuyafutilia mbali.

vi.L: Nhưng nó không có ý như vậy, \q lòng nó không tính như vậy; \q vì lòng nó chỉ muốn hủy diệt, \q và diệt trừ các dân tộc, không phải ít.
vi.B: Nhưng nó không nghĩ như vậy; \q lòng nó không tính toán như thế. \q Điều nó ấp ủ trong lòng là tiêu diệt, là chặt bỏ không ít dân tộc.
vi.R: Nhưng vua A-si-ri không nghĩ như vậy. \q Đó không phải là điều hắn dự tính. \q Hắn chỉ muốn tiêu diệt nhiều dân tộc và xóa sạch họ.

decisions.choice: he does not intend so: Assyria does not know it serves God
decisions.reason: God sends Assyria to punish (verse 6), but Assyria has its own aim: conquest for its own glory. The same events are God's purpose and Assyria's ambition, and God holds Assyria to account for its aim (verses 12-15).

decisions.choice: heart: the mind and will
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is where one thinks and plans, not only where one feels.

decisions.choice: the king of Assyria
decisions.reason: Readable names the king, who speaks in verses 8-11 and is named in verse 12.

source.text: כִּ֖י יֹאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֥א שָׂרַ֛י יַחְדָּ֖ו מְלָכִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For he says, [are] not my commanders altogether kings?

en.L: For he says, \q "Are not my commanders all of them kings?
en.B: For he says, \q "My commanders, are they not kings, every one of them?
en.R: The king of Assyria brags, \q "Every one of my army commanders is as great as a king!

es.L: Porque dice: \q «¿No son mis comandantes todos ellos reyes?
es.B: Porque dice: \q «Mis comandantes, ¿no son reyes todos ellos?
es.R: El rey de Asiria se jacta: \q «¡Cada uno de los comandantes de mi ejército es tan grande como un rey!

fr.L: Car il dit : \q « Mes chefs ne sont-ils pas tous des rois ?
fr.B: Car il dit : \q « Mes chefs, ne sont-ils pas tous des rois ?
fr.R: Le roi d’Assyrie se vante : \q « Chacun des chefs de mon armée est aussi grand qu’un roi !

sw.L: Kwa maana anasema, \q "Je, maakida wangu si wafalme wote?
sw.B: Kwa maana anasema, \q "Maakida wangu, je, si wafalme wote?
sw.R: Mfalme wa Ashuru anajivuna, \q "Kila mmoja wa makamanda wa jeshi langu ni mkuu kama mfalme!

vi.L: Vì nó nói: \q "Chẳng phải các tướng của ta đều là vua sao?
vi.B: Vì nó nói: \q "Các tướng của ta, chẳng phải ai nấy đều là vua sao?
vi.R: Vua A-si-ri khoác lác: \q "Mỗi tướng chỉ huy của ta đều lớn như một vị vua!

decisions.choice: my commanders ... kings: the boast of the great king
decisions.reason: The Assyrian kings called themselves "king of kings". Conquered kings served as his officers, and his governors had the power of kings. The boast is that his servants are as great as the rulers of other lands.

decisions.choice: he says: the king's speech runs to the end of verse 11
decisions.reason: The quotation opens here and closes at the end of verse 11.

decisions.choice: brags ... as great as a king
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies and names the speaker.

source.text: הֲלֹ֥א כְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ כַּלְנ֑וֹ אִם־לֹ֤א כְאַרְפַּד֙ חֲמָ֔ת אִם־לֹ֥א כְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: [Is] not like Carchemish Calno? Or not like Arpad Hamath? Or not like Damascus Samaria?

en.L: [Is] not Calno like Carchemish? \q Or [is] not Hamath like Arpad? \q Or [is] not Samaria like Damascus?
en.B: Did Calno not go the way of Carchemish? \q Did Hamath not go the way of Arpad, \q and Samaria the way of Damascus?
en.R: I conquered the city of Calno just as I conquered Carchemish. \q I took Hamath just as I took Arpad. \q And I took Samaria just as I took Damascus.

es.L: ¿No [es] Calno como Carquemis? \q ¿No [es] Hamat como Arfad? \q ¿No [es] Samaria como Damasco?
es.B: ¿No corrió Calno la suerte de Carquemis? \q ¿No corrió Hamat la suerte de Arfad, \q y Samaria la de Damasco?
es.R: Conquisté la ciudad de Calno, así como conquisté Carquemis. \q Tomé Hamat, así como tomé Arfad. \q Y tomé Samaria, así como tomé Damasco.

fr.L: Kalno n’[est-elle] pas comme Karkemish ? \q Hamath n’[est-elle] pas comme Arpad ? \q Samarie n’[est-elle] pas comme Damas ?
fr.B: Kalno n’a-t-elle pas eu le sort de Karkemish ? \q Hamath, celui d’Arpad, \q et Samarie, celui de Damas ?
fr.R: J’ai conquis la ville de Kalno comme j’ai conquis Karkemish. \q J’ai pris Hamath comme j’ai pris Arpad. \q Et j’ai pris Samarie comme j’ai pris Damas.

sw.L: Je, Kalno si kama Karkemishi? \q Au Hamathi si kama Arpadi? \q Au Samaria si kama Dameski?
sw.B: Je, Kalno haikwenda njia ya Karkemishi? \q Je, Hamathi haikwenda njia ya Arpadi, \q na Samaria njia ya Dameski?
sw.R: Niliushinda mji wa Kalno kama nilivyoushinda Karkemishi. \q Niliuteka Hamathi kama nilivyouteka Arpadi. \q Niliuteka Samaria kama nilivyouteka Dameski.

vi.L: Ca-nô há chẳng như Cạt-kê-mít sao? \q Ha-mát há chẳng như Ạt-bát sao? \q Sa-ma-ri há chẳng như Đa-mách sao?
vi.B: Ca-nô chẳng phải đã chịu chung số phận với Cạt-kê-mít sao? \q Ha-mát chẳng phải đã như Ạt-bát, \q và Sa-ma-ri như Đa-mách sao?
vi.R: Ta đã chinh phục thành Ca-nô như đã chinh phục Cạt-kê-mít. \q Ta đã chiếm Ha-mát như đã chiếm Ạt-bát. \q Ta đã chiếm Sa-ma-ri như đã chiếm Đa-mách.

decisions.choice: Carchemish, Calno, Arpad, Hamath, Damascus, Samaria: cities Assyria had taken
decisions.reason: Each pair names cities in Syria and Israel that fell one after another to Assyria, moving south toward Jerusalem. Damascus fell to Tiglath-pileser III in 732 BC, and Samaria fell in 722 BC. Calno is the Calneh of Amos 6:2. Each city is said to be no different from the one before it.

decisions.choice: is not ... like: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The questions mean: each city fell just like the last. None of them could stand, and the king expects Jerusalem to be next.

decisions.choice: I conquered ... I took
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the questions as the king's boast.

decisions.choice: "Ca-nô" (Calno); "Ạt-bát" as 2 Kings 18:34
decisions.reason: Calno is a new name, transliterated in the usual pattern; Hamath, Arpad and Carchemish keep their published forms. The king speaks of himself as "ta", lowercase, as kings do in Kings.

source.text: כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ מָצְאָ֣ה יָדִ֔י לְמַמְלְכֹ֖ת הָאֱלִ֑יל וּפְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם מִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּמִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Just as has found my hand the kingdoms of the idol, and their images [were] more than Jerusalem and than Samaria,

en.L: Just as my hand has reached the kingdoms of the idol, \q and their images [were more] than Jerusalem's and Samaria's,
en.B: Just as my hand laid hold of kingdoms full of idols, \q whose carved images outnumbered those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
en.R: I have captured kingdoms that had more idols than Jerusalem and Samaria.

es.L: Así como mi mano alcanzó los reinos del ídolo, \q y sus imágenes [eran más] que las de Jerusalén y de Samaria,
es.B: Así como mi mano se apoderó de reinos llenos de ídolos, \q cuyas imágenes talladas superaban a las de Jerusalén y Samaria,
es.R: He conquistado reinos que tenían más ídolos que Jerusalén y Samaria.

fr.L: Comme ma main a atteint les royaumes de l’idole, \q dont les statues [surpassaient] celles de Jérusalem et de Samarie,
fr.B: De même que ma main s’est emparée de royaumes pleins d’idoles, \q dont les statues étaient plus nombreuses que celles de Jérusalem et de Samarie,
fr.R: J’ai conquis des royaumes qui avaient plus d’idoles que Jérusalem et Samarie.

sw.L: Kama vile mkono wangu ulivyozifikia falme za sanamu, \q na sanamu zao za kuchonga [zilikuwa nyingi] kuliko za Yerusalemu na za Samaria,
sw.B: Kama vile mkono wangu ulivyozikamata falme zilizojaa sanamu, \q ambazo sanamu zao za kuchonga zilizidi zile za Yerusalemu na Samaria,
sw.R: Nimeziteka falme zilizokuwa na sanamu nyingi kuliko Yerusalemu na Samaria.

vi.L: Như tay ta đã đoạt được các vương quốc của hình tượng, \q mà tượng chạm của chúng [nhiều hơn] của Giê-ru-sa-lem và Sa-ma-ri,
vi.B: Như tay ta đã chiếm lấy những vương quốc đầy thần tượng, \q có tượng chạm còn nhiều hơn của Giê-ru-sa-lem và Sa-ma-ri,
vi.R: Ta đã chiếm được những vương quốc có nhiều thần tượng hơn Giê-ru-sa-lem và Sa-ma-ri.

decisions.choice: idol, images: worthless gods and carved figures
decisions.reason: The first word means "worthless thing, nothing", Isaiah's word for false gods (2:8, 18, 20). The second is a carved figure. Isaiah lets the king of Assyria speak of the gods of nations as worthless idols, as he goes on to treat the LORD as one more of them.

decisions.choice: more than Jerusalem and Samaria: greater in number or in power
decisions.reason: The boast is that the gods of the conquered kingdoms were greater than those of Jerusalem and Samaria, yet they did not save their peoples (36:18-20; 37:12-13).

decisions.choice: I have captured ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the comparison of verses 10-11 two separate sentences.

source.text: הֲלֹ֗א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי לְשֹׁמְר֖וֹן וְלֶאֱלִילֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְלַעֲצַבֶּֽיהָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not just as I did to Samaria and to its idols so I will do to Jerusalem and to its images?

en.L: Shall I not, just as I did to Samaria and to her idols, \q so do to Jerusalem and to her images?"
en.B: what I did to Samaria and its idols, \q will I not do the same to Jerusalem and its images?"
en.R: I destroyed Samaria and its idols. \q Now I will do the same thing to Jerusalem and its idols!"

es.L: ¿No haré, así como hice a Samaria y a sus ídolos, \q así a Jerusalén y a sus imágenes?».
es.B: lo que hice con Samaria y sus ídolos, \q ¿no lo haré también con Jerusalén y sus imágenes?».
es.R: Destruí Samaria y sus ídolos. \q ¡Ahora haré lo mismo con Jerusalén y sus ídolos!».

fr.L: ne ferai-je pas, comme j’ai fait à Samarie et à ses idoles, \q ainsi à Jérusalem et à ses statues ? »
fr.B: ce que j’ai fait à Samarie et à ses idoles, \q ne le ferai-je pas aussi à Jérusalem et à ses statues ? »
fr.R: J’ai détruit Samarie et ses idoles. \q Maintenant, je vais faire la même chose à Jérusalem et à ses idoles ! »

sw.L: je, sitafanya hivyo kwa Yerusalemu na kwa sanamu zake, \q kama nilivyofanya kwa Samaria na kwa sanamu zake?"
sw.B: yale niliyoitendea Samaria na sanamu zake, \q je, sitaitendea Yerusalemu na sanamu zake vivyo hivyo?"
sw.R: Niliuangamiza Samaria na sanamu zake. \q Sasa nitafanya vivyo hivyo kwa Yerusalemu na sanamu zake!"

vi.L: thì như ta đã làm cho Sa-ma-ri và các hình tượng nó, \q ta há chẳng làm như vậy cho Giê-ru-sa-lem và các tượng của nó sao?"
vi.B: thì điều ta đã làm cho Sa-ma-ri và các thần tượng nó, \q chẳng lẽ ta không làm y như vậy cho Giê-ru-sa-lem và các tượng của nó sao?"
vi.R: Ta đã tiêu diệt Sa-ma-ri và các thần tượng của nó. \q Bây giờ ta cũng sẽ làm y như vậy với Giê-ru-sa-lem và các thần tượng của nó!"

decisions.choice: Samaria ... Jerusalem: the king counts the LORD among the idols
decisions.reason: To the king of Assyria, Jerusalem's God is one more idol like those of Samaria. This is the pride for which God will punish him (verse 12; 36:18-20; 37:23).

decisions.choice: not ... so I will do: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The question means "of course I will". It ends the king's speech that began in verse 8.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יְבַצַּ֤ע אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ בְּהַ֥ר צִיּ֖וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶפְקֹ֗ד עַל־פְּרִי־גֹ֨דֶל֙ לְבַ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֔וּר וְעַל־תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת ר֥וּם עֵינָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be when finishes [the] Lord all his work on [the] mountain of Zion and in Jerusalem, I will visit on [the] fruit of [the] greatness of [the] heart of [the] king of Assyria and on [the] glory of [the] haughtiness of his eyes.

en.L: And it will be, when the Lord finishes all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, \q I will punish the fruit of the greatness of heart of the king of Assyria, \q and the glory of the haughtiness of his eyes.
en.B: When the Lord has completed everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is doing on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, \q I will punish what has grown from the swollen pride of the king of Assyria, \q and the glory of his haughty look.
en.R: The Lord will finish all {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned to do on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem. \q Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says: I will punish the king of Assyria for his proud heart and for the arrogant look in his eyes.

es.L: Y sucederá que, cuando el Señor haya acabado toda {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén, \q castigaré el fruto de la altivez de corazón del rey de Asiria, \q y la gloria de la arrogancia de sus ojos.
es.B: Cuando el Señor haya terminado todo lo que está haciendo en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén, \q castigaré lo que ha brotado del orgullo hinchado del rey de Asiria \q y la gloria de su mirada altiva.
es.R: El Señor terminará todo lo que ha planeado hacer en el monte Sion y en Jerusalén. \q Entonces dice: Castigaré al rey de Asiria por su corazón orgulloso y por la mirada arrogante de sus ojos.

fr.L: Et il arrivera, quand le Seigneur aura achevé toute {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} œuvre sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem, \q que je punirai le fruit de la grandeur du cœur du roi d’Assyrie, \q et la gloire de la hauteur de ses yeux.
fr.B: Quand le Seigneur aura achevé tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem, \q je punirai ce qu’a produit l’orgueil démesuré du roi d’Assyrie, \q et la gloire de son regard hautain.
fr.R: Le Seigneur terminera tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prévu de faire sur le mont Sion et à Jérusalem. \q Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : Je punirai le roi d’Assyrie pour son cœur orgueilleux et pour son regard plein d’arrogance.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, Bwana atakapomaliza kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote katika mlima Sayuni na katika Yerusalemu, \q nitayaadhibu matunda ya ukuu wa moyo wa mfalme wa Ashuru, \q na utukufu wa majivuno ya macho yake.
sw.B: Bwana atakapokuwa amekamilisha yote anayoyatenda katika mlima Sayuni na Yerusalemu, \q nitaadhibu yale yaliyozaliwa na kiburi kilichojaa moyoni mwa mfalme wa Ashuru, \q na fahari ya macho yake ya majivuno.
sw.R: Bwana atamaliza yote aliyopanga kufanya katika mlima Sayuni na Yerusalemu. \q Kisha anasema: Nitamwadhibu mfalme wa Ashuru kwa moyo wake wa kiburi na kwa macho yake ya majivuno.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra, khi Chúa đã làm xong mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q Ta sẽ phạt bông trái của lòng tự cao của vua A-si-ri, \q và vẻ vinh hiển của ánh mắt kiêu ngạo của nó.
vi.B: Khi Chúa đã hoàn tất mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q Ta sẽ trừng phạt kết quả của lòng kiêu căng của vua A-si-ri, \q và vẻ vinh hiển của cái nhìn ngạo mạn của nó.
vi.R: Chúa sẽ hoàn tất mọi việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định làm trên núi Si-ôn và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: Ta sẽ trừng phạt vua A-si-ri vì lòng kiêu ngạo và ánh mắt ngạo mạn của nó.

decisions.choice: I will punish: the speaker moves from "the Lord" to "I"
decisions.reason: The verse begins by speaking of the Lord and then has him say "I". This shift of person is common in the prophets: the prophet speaks of God, and then God speaks for himself.

decisions.choice: when the Lord finishes all his work: the judgment on Zion has a limit
decisions.reason: God's work of discipline on Jerusalem by means of Assyria will run its course and then stop. After that, the tool will be judged (verses 24-27).

decisions.choice: the fruit of the greatness of heart ... the glory of the haughtiness of his eyes: arrogance and its results
decisions.reason: A "great heart" is pride (9:8, Hebrew numbering), and lifted-up eyes are an arrogant look (2:11; 5:15). The "fruit" is what the pride has produced: the boasting of verses 8-11 and the deeds behind it.

decisions.choice: Then he says:
decisions.reason: Readable marks the change from speaking about the Lord to the Lord speaking.

source.text: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר בְּכֹ֤חַ יָדִי֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּבְחָכְמָתִ֖י כִּ֣י נְבֻנ֑וֹתִי וְאָסִ֣יר׀גְּבוּלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֗ים וַעֲתוּדֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ שׁוֹשֵׂ֔תִי וְאוֹרִ֥יד כַּאבִּ֖יר יוֹשְׁבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For he says, by [the] strength of my hand I have done [it], and by my wisdom, for I have understanding; and I have removed [the] borders of peoples, and their treasures I have plundered, and I have brought down like a mighty one those sitting.

en.L: For he says, "By the strength of my hand I have done [it], \q and by my wisdom, for I have understanding; \q and I removed the borders of peoples, and their treasures I plundered, \q and like a mighty one I brought down those sitting [enthroned].
en.B: For he says, "My own strong hand has done this, \q and my wisdom, for I am shrewd. \q I wiped away the borders between peoples and stripped their storehouses bare; \q like a mighty bull I toppled those who sat on thrones.
en.R: The king of Assyria says, "I did all this by my own power. \q I did it because I am wise and clever. \q I erased the borders between nations. I took their treasures. \q Like a powerful bull, I knocked kings off their thrones.

es.L: Porque dice: «Con la fuerza de mi mano lo he hecho, \q y con mi sabiduría, porque soy entendido; \q y quité los límites de los pueblos, y saqueé sus tesoros, \q y como un poderoso derribé a los que estaban sentados [en tronos].
es.B: Porque dice: «Mi propia mano fuerte ha hecho esto, \q y mi sabiduría, porque soy astuto. \q Borré las fronteras entre los pueblos y vacié sus almacenes; \q como un toro poderoso derribé a los que se sentaban en tronos.
es.R: El rey de Asiria dice: «Hice todo esto con mi propio poder. \q Lo hice porque soy sabio y listo. \q Borré las fronteras entre las naciones. Me llevé sus tesoros. \q Como un toro poderoso, derribé a los reyes de sus tronos.

fr.L: Car il dit : « Par la force de ma main j’ai agi, \q et par ma sagesse, car je suis intelligent ; \q et j’ai supprimé les frontières des peuples, et leurs trésors je les ai pillés, \q et comme un puissant j’ai fait descendre ceux qui siégeaient.
fr.B: Car il dit : « C’est ma main puissante qui a fait cela, \q et ma sagesse, car je suis habile. \q J’ai effacé les frontières entre les peuples et vidé leurs réserves ; \q comme un taureau puissant, j’ai renversé ceux qui siégeaient sur des trônes.
fr.R: Le roi d’Assyrie dit : « J’ai fait tout cela par ma propre force. \q Je l’ai fait parce que je suis sage et intelligent. \q J’ai effacé les frontières entre les nations. J’ai pris leurs trésors. \q Comme un taureau puissant, j’ai fait tomber les rois de leurs trônes.

sw.L: Kwa maana anasema, "Kwa nguvu za mkono wangu nimefanya [hivi], \q na kwa hekima yangu, kwa maana nina ufahamu; \q nami nimeiondoa mipaka ya mataifa, na hazina zao nimeziteka, \q na kama shujaa nimewashusha wale walioketi [katika viti vya enzi].
sw.B: Kwa maana anasema, "Mkono wangu wenye nguvu ndio uliofanya hivi, \q na hekima yangu, kwa maana mimi ni mwerevu. \q Niliifuta mipaka kati ya mataifa na kuziteka hazina zao zote; \q kama fahali mwenye nguvu niliwaangusha walioketi katika viti vya enzi.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Ashuru anasema, "Nimefanya haya yote kwa nguvu zangu mwenyewe. \q Nimeyafanya kwa sababu nina hekima na akili. \q Nimeifuta mipaka kati ya mataifa. Nimezichukua hazina zao. \q Kama fahali mwenye nguvu, nimewaangusha wafalme kutoka katika viti vyao vya enzi.

vi.L: Vì nó nói: "Ta đã làm [điều đó] bởi sức mạnh của tay ta, \q và bởi sự khôn ngoan của ta, vì ta thông sáng; \q ta đã dời bỏ ranh giới các dân, cướp lấy kho báu của chúng, \q và như một kẻ mạnh, ta đã hạ những kẻ ngồi [trên ngai].
vi.B: Vì nó nói: "Chính bàn tay mạnh mẽ của ta đã làm điều này, \q và sự khôn ngoan của ta, vì ta sáng suốt. \q Ta đã xóa bỏ ranh giới giữa các dân, vét sạch kho tàng của chúng; \q như một con bò mộng, ta đã lật đổ những kẻ ngồi trên ngai.
vi.R: Vua A-si-ri nói: "Ta đã làm tất cả điều này bằng sức mạnh của chính ta. \q Ta làm được vì ta khôn ngoan và giỏi giang. \q Ta đã xóa bỏ biên giới giữa các nước. Ta đã lấy hết kho báu của họ. \q Như một con bò mộng, ta đã hất các vua khỏi ngai.

decisions.choice: their treasures: the reading of the margin
decisions.reason: The reading in the margin means "their stored treasures". The written text has a similar word meaning "what is prepared for them" or "their future". The sense is close either way: he has looted what nations had laid up.

decisions.choice: like a mighty one: like a bull, a strong man
decisions.reason: The word means mighty, and is also used of a bull or a powerful animal (34:7; Psalm 22:13). The written text can also be read "I brought down, mighty as I am".

decisions.choice: those sitting: those enthroned, or the inhabitants
decisions.reason: The word means "those who sit" or "those who dwell". Beside "brought down" it most likely means kings on their thrones, though it may mean the peoples who lived in the lands.

decisions.choice: a mighty bull
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the strength of the word and its picture of a charging bull.

source.text: וַתִּמְצָ֨א כַקֵּ֤ן׀יָדִי֙ לְחֵ֣יל הָֽעַמִּ֔ים וְכֶאֱסֹף֙ בֵּיצִ֣ים עֲזֻב֔וֹת כָּל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲנִ֣י אָסָ֑פְתִּי וְלֹ֤א הָיָה֙ נֹדֵ֣ד כָּנָ֔ף וּפֹצֶ֥ה פֶ֖ה וּמְצַפְצֵֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And has found like a nest my hand the wealth of the peoples, and as gathers [one] eggs abandoned all the earth I have gathered, and not was [one] fluttering a wing, and opening a mouth, and chirping.

en.L: And my hand has found like a nest the wealth of the peoples, \q and as [one] gathers abandoned eggs, \q I have gathered all the earth; \q and there was none fluttering a wing or opening a mouth or chirping."
en.B: My hand found the riches of the peoples as easily as a bird's nest; \q the way someone collects eggs that have been deserted, \q I collected the whole earth. \q No wing fluttered; no beak opened; no peep was heard."
en.R: Taking the riches of the nations was as easy as reaching into a bird's nest. \q I gathered up the whole earth the way someone gathers eggs that the mother bird has left. \q No one even flapped a wing or opened a mouth to make a sound!"

es.L: Y mi mano halló como un nido la riqueza de los pueblos, \q y como [quien] recoge huevos abandonados, \q yo recogí toda la tierra; \q y no hubo quien moviera un ala, ni abriera el pico, ni piara».
es.B: Mi mano encontró las riquezas de los pueblos tan fácilmente como un nido de pájaro; \q como quien recoge huevos abandonados, \q recogí toda la tierra. \q Ningún ala se agitó, ningún pico se abrió, no se oyó ni un pío».
es.R: Llevarme las riquezas de las naciones fue tan fácil como meter la mano en un nido de pájaros. \q Recogí toda la tierra como quien recoge los huevos que la madre ha abandonado. \q ¡Nadie movió siquiera un ala ni abrió la boca para hacer ruido!».

fr.L: Et ma main a trouvé comme un nid la richesse des peuples, \q et comme on ramasse des œufs abandonnés, \q moi, j’ai ramassé toute la terre ; \q et il n’y a eu personne pour battre de l’aile, ou ouvrir le bec, ou piailler. »
fr.B: Ma main a trouvé les richesses des peuples aussi facilement qu’un nid ; \q comme on ramasse des œufs abandonnés, \q j’ai ramassé la terre entière. \q Pas une aile n’a battu ; pas un bec ne s’est ouvert ; pas un cri ne s’est fait entendre. »
fr.R: Prendre les richesses des nations a été aussi facile que de mettre la main dans un nid d’oiseau. \q J’ai ramassé toute la terre comme on ramasse des œufs que la mère a abandonnés. \q Personne n’a même battu de l’aile ni ouvert le bec pour faire un bruit ! »

sw.L: Na mkono wangu umeupata kama kiota utajiri wa mataifa, \q na kama [mtu] akusanyavyo mayai yaliyoachwa, \q nimeikusanya dunia yote; \q wala hapakuwa na mtu aliyepigapiga bawa, au kufungua kinywa, au kulia."
sw.B: Mkono wangu ulipata utajiri wa mataifa kwa urahisi kama kiota cha ndege; \q kama mtu akusanyavyo mayai yaliyoachwa, \q niliikusanya dunia yote. \q Hakuna bawa lililopiga, hakuna mdomo uliofunguka, hakuna sauti iliyosikika."
sw.R: Kuchukua mali za mataifa kulikuwa rahisi kama kuingiza mkono katika kiota cha ndege. \q Niliikusanya dunia yote kama mtu anavyokusanya mayai ambayo ndege mama ameyaacha. \q Hakuna aliyepiga hata bawa wala kufungua mdomo kutoa sauti!"

vi.L: Tay ta đã tìm được của cải các dân như [tìm] một ổ chim, \q và như người ta lượm trứng bị bỏ, \q ta đã thu gom cả trái đất; \q chẳng có con nào vỗ cánh, há mỏ hay kêu chiêm chiếp."
vi.B: Tay ta đã tìm thấy của cải các dân dễ như tìm một ổ chim; \q như người ta lượm những quả trứng bị bỏ lại, \q ta đã thu gom cả trái đất. \q Không một cánh nào vỗ, không một mỏ nào há ra, không một tiếng kêu nào."
vi.R: Lấy của cải các dân tộc dễ như thò tay vào ổ chim. \q Ta đã thu gom cả trái đất như người ta lượm trứng chim mẹ đã bỏ. \q Không ai dám vỗ cánh hay há miệng kêu lên một tiếng!"

decisions.choice: like a nest ... abandoned eggs: plunder taken with no resistance
decisions.reason: The king pictures the nations as a nest whose mother bird has flown away. Robbing it was easy and no one fought back: not a wing moved, not a beak opened.

decisions.choice: I have gathered: the boast ends
decisions.reason: The word "I" is stated for emphasis. The king's speech that began in verse 13 closes here.

source.text: הֲיִתְפָּאֵר֙ הַגַּרְזֶ֔ן עַ֖ל הַחֹצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ אִם־יִתְגַּדֵּ֤ל הַמַּשּׂוֹר֙ עַל־מְנִיפ֔וֹ כְּהָנִ֥יף שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ וְאֶת־מְרִימָ֔יו כְּהָרִ֥ים מַטֶּ֖ה לֹא־עֵֽץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Does it glorify itself, the axe, over the one cutting with it? Or does it make itself great, the saw, over the one wielding it? As [if] wielded a rod those lifting it, as [if] lifted a staff [one who is] not wood!

en.L: Shall the axe glorify itself over the one who cuts with it? \q Or shall the saw make itself great over the one who wields it? \q As if a rod should wield those who lift it, \q as if a staff should lift [one who is] not wood!
en.B: Can an ax take pride over the one who chops with it, \q or a saw make itself greater than the one who works it? \q That would be like a stick swinging the hands that lift it, \q or a wooden club lifting someone who is not wood!
en.R: Can an ax brag that it is greater than the person who uses it to chop? \q Can a saw act more important than the person who uses it to cut? \q That is like a stick swinging the person who picks it up! \q A wooden club cannot lift a person. Assyria is only a tool in God's hand.

es.L: ¿Se gloriará el hacha contra el que corta con ella? \q ¿O se engrandecerá la sierra contra el que la maneja? \q ¡Como si la vara moviera a los que la levantan, \q como si el bastón levantara al que no es madera!
es.B: ¿Puede un hacha enorgullecerse frente al que corta con ella, \q o una sierra creerse más grande que el que la usa? \q ¡Sería como si un palo blandiera las manos que lo levantan, \q o como si un garrote de madera levantara a alguien que no es de madera!
es.R: ¿Puede un hacha jactarse de ser más grande que la persona que la usa para cortar? \q ¿Puede una sierra creerse más importante que la persona que la usa para serrar? \q ¡Eso sería como si un palo moviera a la persona que lo agarra! \q Un garrote de madera no puede levantar a una persona. Asiria es solo una herramienta en la mano de Dios.

fr.L: La hache se glorifiera-t-elle contre celui qui taille avec elle ? \q Ou la scie se grandira-t-elle contre celui qui la manie ? \q Comme si une verge maniait ceux qui la lèvent, \q comme si un bâton levait [celui qui n’est] pas du bois !
fr.B: La hache peut-elle se vanter devant celui qui coupe avec elle, \q ou la scie se croire plus grande que celui qui la manie ? \q Ce serait comme un bâton qui agiterait les mains qui le lèvent, \q ou un gourdin de bois qui soulèverait quelqu’un qui n’est pas du bois !
fr.R: Une hache peut-elle se vanter d’être plus grande que celui qui s’en sert pour couper ? \q Une scie peut-elle se croire plus importante que celui qui s’en sert pour scier ? \q Ce serait comme un bâton qui agiterait celui qui le ramasse ! \q Un gourdin de bois ne peut pas soulever une personne. L’Assyrie n’est qu’un outil dans la main de Dieu.

sw.L: Je, shoka litajitukuza juu ya yule anayekata nalo? \q Au msumeno utajikuza juu ya yule anayeutumia? \q Kana kwamba fimbo ingewaendesha wale wanaoiinua, \q kana kwamba gongo lingemwinua [mtu ambaye] si mti!
sw.B: Je, shoka laweza kujivuna juu ya yule anayekata kwalo, \q au msumeno kujifanya mkuu kuliko yule anayeufanyia kazi? \q Hiyo ingekuwa kama fimbo kuipunga mikono inayoiinua, \q au rungu la mti kumwinua mtu asiye mti!
sw.R: Je, shoka laweza kujisifu kwamba ni kubwa kuliko mtu anayelitumia kukata? \q Je, msumeno waweza kujiona kuwa muhimu kuliko mtu anayeutumia kukata? \q Hiyo ni kama fimbo kumpunga mtu anayeiokota! \q Rungu la mti haliwezi kumwinua mtu. Ashuru ni chombo tu mkononi mwa Mungu.

vi.L: Cái rìu há khoe mình hơn người dùng nó để đốn sao? \q Cái cưa há tự tôn mình hơn người kéo nó sao? \q Như thể cây roi vung những người cầm nó lên, \q như thể cây gậy nhấc bổng [người] chẳng phải là gỗ!
vi.B: Cái rìu có thể kiêu căng trước người cầm nó mà chặt sao? \q Cái cưa có thể tự tôn mình hơn người kéo nó sao? \q Như thế khác nào cây gậy vung đôi tay cầm nó lên, \q hay cây côn gỗ nhấc bổng người chẳng phải là gỗ!
vi.R: Cái rìu có thể khoe rằng nó lớn hơn người dùng nó để chặt không? \q Cái cưa có thể tự cho mình quan trọng hơn người dùng nó để cưa không? \q Điều đó giống như cây gậy vung người cầm nó lên! \q Một cây gậy gỗ không thể nhấc bổng một con người. A-si-ri chỉ là một công cụ trong tay Đức Chúa Trời.

decisions.choice: axe, saw, rod, staff: Assyria is only God's tool
decisions.reason: God answers the king's boast with a question. A tool cannot boast against the one who uses it; Assyria has done nothing that God did not use it to do (verses 5-6).

decisions.choice: not wood: a living person
decisions.reason: "Not wood" is the one who holds the staff, the living person who is not a piece of timber. The picture is absurd on purpose: a stick lifting the one who holds it.

decisions.choice: Assyria is only a tool in God's hand.
decisions.reason: Readable states the point of the comparison, which verses 5 and 15 together make.

source.text: לָ֠כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו רָז֑וֹן וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore will send the Lord, Yahweh of hosts, on his fat ones leanness, and under his glory will be kindled a kindling like [the] kindling of fire.

en.L: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts will send leanness among his fat ones, \q and under his glory a burning will burn like the burning of fire.
en.B: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies will send a wasting disease into his well-fed troops, \q and beneath his splendor a blaze will flare up like a burning fire.
en.R: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies will send a disease that makes the king of Assyria's strong soldiers waste away. \q Under all his glory, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will light a fire that burns everything.

es.L: Por tanto, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos enviará flaqueza entre sus robustos, \q y debajo de su gloria arderá un incendio como incendio de fuego.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos enviará una enfermedad que consumirá a sus tropas bien alimentadas, \q y bajo su esplendor se encenderá una hoguera como un fuego ardiente.
es.R: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos enviará una enfermedad que hará que los fuertes soldados del rey de Asiria se consuman. \q Debajo de toda su gloria, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} encenderá un fuego que lo quemará todo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées enverra la maigreur parmi ses hommes gras, \q et sous sa gloire s’allumera un embrasement comme l’embrasement d’un feu.
fr.B: Aussi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées enverra une maladie qui consume parmi ses troupes bien nourries, \q et sous sa splendeur s’allumera un brasier comme un feu ardent.
fr.R: Alors le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées enverra une maladie qui fera dépérir les soldats robustes du roi d’Assyrie. \q Sous toute sa gloire, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} allumera un feu qui brûlera tout.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atapeleka ukonda kati ya walionona wake, \q na chini ya utukufu wake moto utawaka kama kuwaka kwa moto.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atapeleka ugonjwa wa kudhoofisha kati ya askari wake walioshiba, \q na chini ya fahari yake moto utalipuka kama moto unaowaka.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atapeleka ugonjwa utakaowadhoofisha askari hodari wa mfalme wa Ashuru. \q Chini ya utukufu wake wote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawasha moto utakaoteketeza kila kitu.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ sai sự gầy mòn đến giữa những kẻ béo mập của nó, \q và dưới vinh quang nó, một đám cháy sẽ bùng lên như lửa cháy.
vi.B: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ giáng bệnh gầy mòn trên những đạo quân béo tốt của nó, \q và bên dưới vẻ huy hoàng của nó, một ngọn lửa sẽ bùng cháy như đám lửa thiêu.
vi.R: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ giáng một bệnh dịch làm cho những binh lính khỏe mạnh của vua A-si-ri gầy mòn. \q Bên dưới mọi vinh quang của hắn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ nhóm lên một ngọn lửa thiêu rụi mọi thứ.

decisions.choice: leanness among his fat ones: a wasting sickness among strong men
decisions.reason: "Fat ones" are the well-fed, sturdy warriors of the king of Assyria; "leanness" is a disease that wastes the body away (Psalm 106:15). The words look ahead to the sudden end of Assyria's army before Jerusalem in 701 BC (37:36).

decisions.choice: under his glory: the king's pomp, or his army
decisions.reason: "His glory" is the king's splendor and may stand for his army, his nobles and his wealth. The fire burns beneath it, as in a forest, as the next verses go on to picture.

decisions.choice: the Lord, Yahweh of hosts: the title with the article
decisions.reason: The word for Lord here has the article ("the Lord", the master), as in verse 33 and 1:24. The full title stresses that the Master of the armies of heaven acts against the great king.

decisions.choice: the king of Assyria's strong soldiers ... the LORD will light
decisions.reason: Readable names whose men are meant and who lights the fire.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְאֵ֔שׁ וּקְדוֹשׁ֖וֹ לְלֶהָבָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֗ה וְאָֽכְלָ֛ה שִׁית֥וֹ וּשְׁמִיר֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And will become [the] light of Israel a fire, and its Holy One a flame, and it will burn and it will devour his thorns and his briers in day one.

en.L: And the Light of Israel will become a fire, \q and his Holy One a flame, \q and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
en.B: The one who is Israel's Light will turn to fire, \q its Holy One to flame; \q it will flare up and burn up his thornbushes and briers, all in a single day.
en.R: God, who is the light of Israel, will become like a fire. \q Israel's Holy One will become like a flame. \q In a single day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will burn up the Assyrian army like a fire burns up thorns and weeds.

es.L: Y la Luz de Israel se convertirá en fuego, \q y su Santo en llama, \q y arderá y devorará sus espinos y sus cardos en un solo día.
es.B: El que es la Luz de Israel se convertirá en fuego, \q su Santo en llama; \q se encenderá y consumirá sus espinos y sus cardos, todo en un solo día.
es.R: Dios, que es la luz de Israel, se volverá como un fuego. \q El Santo de Israel se volverá como una llama. \q En un solo día {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quemará al ejército asirio como el fuego quema espinos y malezas.

fr.L: Et la Lumière d’Israël deviendra un feu, \q et son Saint une flamme, \q et elle brûlera et dévorera ses épines et ses ronces en un seul jour.
fr.B: Celui qui est la Lumière d’Israël deviendra un feu, \q son Saint deviendra une flamme ; \q elle s’embrasera et consumera ses buissons d’épines et ses ronces en un seul jour.
fr.R: Dieu, qui est la lumière d’Israël, deviendra comme un feu. \q Le Saint d’Israël deviendra comme une flamme. \q En un seul jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} brûlera l’armée assyrienne comme un feu brûle les épines et les mauvaises herbes.

sw.L: Na Nuru ya Israeli itakuwa moto, \q na Mtakatifu wake mwali, \q nao utawaka na kuila michongoma yake na miiba yake katika siku moja.
sw.B: Yeye aliye Nuru ya Israeli atageuka kuwa moto, \q Mtakatifu wake atakuwa mwali; \q utawaka na kuteketeza michongoma yake na miiba yake, yote katika siku moja.
sw.R: Mungu, aliye nuru ya Israeli, atakuwa kama moto. \q Mtakatifu wa Israeli atakuwa kama mwali wa moto. \q Katika siku moja atateketeza jeshi la Ashuru kama moto unavyoteketeza miiba na magugu.

vi.L: Ánh Sáng của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ trở thành lửa, \q Đấng Thánh của nó [sẽ thành] ngọn lửa, \q sẽ đốt cháy và thiêu nuốt gai góc và bụi gai của nó trong một ngày.
vi.B: Đấng là Ánh Sáng của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ trở thành lửa, \q Đấng Thánh của họ sẽ thành ngọn lửa; \q lửa ấy sẽ bùng lên thiêu rụi gai góc và bụi gai của nó chỉ trong một ngày.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời, là ánh sáng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, sẽ trở nên như lửa. \q Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ trở nên như ngọn lửa. \q Chỉ trong một ngày, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thiêu rụi quân đội A-si-ri như lửa thiêu gai góc và cỏ dại.

decisions.choice: the Light of Israel, its Holy One: God himself
decisions.reason: God, who is Israel's light (2:5; 9:1, Hebrew numbering; Psalm 27:1), becomes a fire to its enemies. "Its Holy One" is the Holy One of Israel, Isaiah's name for God (1:4; verse 20).

decisions.choice: his thorns and his briers: the king of Assyria's army
decisions.reason: "His" is the king of Assyria. The pair of words is Isaiah's "thorns and briers" (5:6; 7:23-25; 9:17, Hebrew numbering), here a picture of the Assyrian host, burned like brushwood.

decisions.choice: the Assyrian army like a fire burns up thorns and weeds
decisions.reason: Readable says who the thorns stand for.

source.text: וּכְב֤וֹד יַעְרוֹ֙ וְכַרְמִלּ֔וֹ מִנֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְעַד־בָּשָׂ֖ר יְכַלֶּ֑ה וְהָיָ֖ה כִּמְסֹ֥ס נֹסֵֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] glory of his forest and his orchard, from soul and to flesh, it will bring to an end, and it will be as wastes away [one who is] sick.

en.L: And the glory of his forest and his orchard it will bring to an end, from soul even to flesh, \q and it will be as [when] a sick [man] wastes away.
en.B: The splendor of his forest and his orchard land it will wipe out, body and soul, \q and it will be as the strength drains out of a sick man.
en.R: The fire will destroy the king's great forests and fine orchards. It will destroy everything, inside and out. \q Assyria will become weak, like a sick person whose strength is gone.

es.L: Y la gloria de su bosque y de su vergel la consumirá, desde el alma hasta la carne, \q y será como cuando un enfermo se consume.
es.B: Acabará con el esplendor de su bosque y de su tierra de huertos, en cuerpo y alma, \q y será como cuando las fuerzas abandonan a un enfermo.
es.R: El fuego destruirá los grandes bosques y los hermosos huertos del rey. Lo destruirá todo, por dentro y por fuera. \q Asiria se debilitará, como un enfermo que se ha quedado sin fuerzas.

fr.L: Et la gloire de sa forêt et de son verger, elle la consumera, de l’âme jusqu’à la chair, \q et ce sera comme quand dépérit un malade.
fr.B: La splendeur de sa forêt et de ses vergers, elle l’anéantira, corps et âme, \q et ce sera comme un malade dont les forces s’en vont.
fr.R: Le feu détruira les grandes forêts et les beaux vergers du roi. Il détruira tout, du dedans comme du dehors. \q L’Assyrie deviendra faible, comme un malade qui n’a plus de force.

sw.L: Na utukufu wa msitu wake na wa shamba lake la matunda utaukomesha, tangu nafsi hata mwili, \q nao utakuwa kama [mtu] mgonjwa anapodhoofika.
sw.B: Fahari ya msitu wake na ya mashamba yake ya matunda itaifutilia mbali, mwili na roho, \q na itakuwa kama nguvu zinavyomtoka mtu mgonjwa.
sw.R: Moto huo utaharibu misitu mikubwa na mashamba mazuri ya matunda ya mfalme. Utaharibu kila kitu, ndani na nje. \q Ashuru itakuwa dhaifu, kama mtu mgonjwa ambaye nguvu zake zimekwisha.

vi.L: Vinh quang của rừng và vườn cây của nó, sẽ bị tiêu hủy, từ linh hồn cho đến thể xác, \q và sẽ như khi một người bệnh hao mòn.
vi.B: Vẻ huy hoàng của rừng rậm và vườn cây của nó sẽ bị tiêu diệt, cả hồn lẫn xác, \q như sức lực của người bệnh hao mòn dần.
vi.R: Ngọn lửa sẽ thiêu hủy những khu rừng lớn và vườn cây đẹp của nhà vua. Nó sẽ tiêu hủy mọi thứ, cả trong lẫn ngoài. \q A-si-ri sẽ trở nên yếu ớt, như người bệnh đã hết sức lực.

decisions.choice: his forest and his orchard: the might and pride of Assyria
decisions.reason: The king boasts of cutting down the forests of Lebanon (37:24). Now his own "forest", his great army and the glory of his kingdom, is burned (verses 33-34).

decisions.choice: from soul to flesh: completely, inside and out
decisions.reason: "Soul" is the life within, "flesh" the body. The phrase means the whole of it, nothing left.

decisions.choice: as a sick man wastes away
decisions.reason: The two words are rare. They may also mean "as a standard-bearer faints", taking the second word from "banner". The picture of wasting sickness fits verse 16.

source.text: וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֵ֛ץ יַעְר֖וֹ מִסְפָּ֣ר יִֽהְי֑וּ וְנַ֖עַר יִכְתְּבֵֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] remnant of [the] trees of his forest a number will be, and a child will write them.

en.L: And the remnant of the trees of his forest will be [few in] number, \q and a child will write them down.
en.B: What is left of the trees in his forest will be so few \q that a child could list them.
en.R: So few trees will be left in his forest \q that even a child could count them.

es.L: Y el resto de los árboles de su bosque será [poco en] número, \q y un niño los podrá escribir.
es.B: Lo que quede de los árboles de su bosque será tan poco \q que un niño podría hacer la lista.
es.R: Quedarán tan pocos árboles en su bosque \q que hasta un niño podría contarlos.

fr.L: Et le reste des arbres de sa forêt sera [peu nombreux], \q et un enfant les inscrira.
fr.B: Ce qui restera des arbres de sa forêt sera si peu \q qu’un enfant pourrait en faire la liste.
fr.R: Il restera si peu d’arbres dans sa forêt \q que même un enfant pourrait les compter.

sw.L: Na mabaki ya miti ya msitu wake yatakuwa [machache kwa] hesabu, \q na mtoto ataiandika.
sw.B: Miti itakayobaki katika msitu wake itakuwa michache \q hata mtoto angeweza kuiorodhesha.
sw.R: Miti michache sana itabaki katika msitu wake \q hata mtoto angeweza kuihesabu.

vi.L: Số cây còn sót lại trong rừng nó sẽ [ít ỏi], \q một đứa trẻ cũng có thể ghi lại được.
vi.B: Số cây còn lại trong rừng nó sẽ ít đến nỗi \q một đứa trẻ cũng có thể kê ra được.
vi.R: Số cây còn lại trong rừng sẽ ít đến nỗi \q một đứa trẻ cũng có thể đếm được.

decisions.choice: a number: few, able to be counted
decisions.reason: To be "a number" means to be few enough to count (Deuteronomy 33:6). A child who could only just write could list them all.

decisions.choice: remnant: the same word as in verses 20-22
decisions.reason: Assyria will have a small remnant of trees; Israel will have a remnant that returns to God. The word links the two halves of the chapter.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹֽא־יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֔ב לְהִשָּׁעֵ֖ן עַל־מַכֵּ֑הוּ וְנִשְׁעַ֗ן עַל־יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in day the that, not will add again [the] remnant of Israel and [the] escaped of [the] house of Jacob to lean on [the one] striking it, and it will lean on Yahweh, [the] Holy One of Israel, in truth.

en.L: And it will be in that day, the remnant of Israel and the escaped of the house of Jacob \q will no longer again lean on the one who struck them, \q but will lean on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
en.B: On that day the remnant of Israel, those of the house of Jacob who have escaped, \q will no longer lean on the one who struck them down. \q Their support will be {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Holy One of Israel, in all faithfulness.
en.R: At that time the people left alive in Israel, the ones from Jacob's family who escape, \q will no longer depend on the nation that beat them down. \q Instead they will truly trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Holy One of Israel.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día que el remanente de Israel y los escapados de la casa de Jacob \q nunca más volverán a apoyarse en el que los golpeó, \q sino que se apoyarán en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Santo de Israel, en verdad.
es.B: Aquel día el remanente de Israel, los de la casa de Jacob que hayan escapado, \q ya no se apoyarán en el que los derribó. \q Su apoyo será {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Santo de Israel, con toda fidelidad.
es.R: En ese tiempo los que queden con vida en Israel, los de la familia de Jacob que escapen, \q ya no dependerán de la nación que los aplastó. \q En cambio, confiarán de verdad en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Santo de Israel.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là que le reste d’Israël et les rescapés de la maison de Jacob \q ne continueront plus à s’appuyer sur celui qui les frappait, \q mais ils s’appuieront sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Saint d’Israël, en vérité.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, le reste d’Israël, ceux de la maison de Jacob qui auront échappé, \q ne s’appuieront plus sur celui qui les a frappés. \q Leur appui sera {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Saint d’Israël, en toute fidélité.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, ceux qui seront restés en vie en Israël, ceux de la famille de Jacob qui auront échappé, \q ne compteront plus sur la nation qui les a écrasés. \q Au contraire, ils feront vraiment confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Saint d’Israël.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, mabaki ya Israeli na waliookoka wa nyumba ya Yakobo \q hawataendelea tena kumtegemea yule aliyewapiga, \q bali watamtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mtakatifu wa Israeli, kwa kweli.
sw.B: Siku hiyo mabaki ya Israeli, wale wa nyumba ya Yakobo walionusurika, \q hawatamtegemea tena yule aliyewapiga. \q Tegemeo lao litakuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mtakatifu wa Israeli, kwa uaminifu wote.
sw.R: Wakati huo watu waliobaki hai katika Israeli, wale wa jamaa ya Yakobo watakaookoka, \q hawatalitegemea tena taifa lililowapiga. \q Badala yake watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mtakatifu wa Israeli, kwa kweli.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên và những người thoát nạn của nhà Gia-cốp \q sẽ không còn nương cậy kẻ đã đánh mình nữa, \q nhưng sẽ thật lòng nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên, những người nhà Gia-cốp đã thoát nạn, \q sẽ không còn nương tựa vào kẻ đã đánh gục họ nữa. \q Họ sẽ trung tín nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, những người còn sống sót trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, tức là những người trong dòng dõi Gia-cốp đã thoát nạn, \q sẽ không còn nương cậy nước đã đánh gục họ nữa. \q Trái lại, họ sẽ thật lòng tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Thánh của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

decisions.choice: remnant, escaped: those left after the judgment
decisions.reason: The remnant is what is left over; the escaped are those who got away alive. Both name the small part of Israel that survives the Assyrian judgment and comes back to God (1:9; 4:2-3).

decisions.choice: lean on the one who struck them: trust in Assyria
decisions.reason: King Ahaz leaned on Assyria for help against Aram and Israel (7:1-17; 2 Kings 16:7-9), and Assyria became the power that struck Judah. The remnant will stop trusting in such help.

decisions.choice: in truth: faithfully, sincerely
decisions.reason: The word means firmness, faithfulness and truth. Their trust will be real and lasting, not in words only.

decisions.choice: the people left alive in Israel ... Jacob's family
decisions.reason: Readable explains "remnant" and "house of Jacob".

decisions.choice: el remanente (L, B); los que queden con vida (R)
decisions.reason: She'ar is "el remanente" at L and B and is explained at R, as the terms note sets it from Romans 9:27 and 11:5. Book-wide choice for chapters 1-20.

decisions.choice: "mabaki" (L, B), "watu waliobaki" (R) for *sheʾar*
decisions.reason: The settled word for the remnant (Romans 9:27; 2 Kings 19:31; terms note), here and in verses 19-22.

decisions.choice: "le reste" (L, B); "ceux qui seront restés en vie" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note’s word for *sheʾar*, as Romans 9:27, for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (L, B); "những người còn sống sót" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for "sheʾar" through the book (2 Kings 19:4, 31).

source.text: שְׁאָ֥ר יָשׁ֖וּב שְׁאָ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֶל־אֵ֖ל גִּבּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: A remnant will return, [the] remnant of Jacob, to God mighty.

en.L: A remnant will return, [the] remnant of Jacob, \q to [the] mighty God.
en.B: A remnant will return, Jacob's remnant, \q to the Mighty God.
en.R: Only a few will be left, but those few from Jacob's family will come back to the Mighty God.

es.L: Un remanente volverá, el remanente de Jacob, \q al Dios Poderoso.
es.B: Un remanente volverá, el remanente de Jacob, \q al Dios Poderoso.
es.R: Solo quedarán unos pocos, pero esos pocos de la familia de Jacob volverán al Dios Poderoso.

fr.L: Un reste reviendra, le reste de Jacob, \q au Dieu puissant.
fr.B: Un reste reviendra, le reste de Jacob, \q au Dieu puissant.
fr.R: Il n’en restera que peu, mais ces quelques-uns de la famille de Jacob reviendront au Dieu puissant.

sw.L: Mabaki watarudi, mabaki ya Yakobo, \q kwa Mungu Shujaa.
sw.B: Mabaki watarudi, mabaki ya Yakobo, \q kwa Mungu Shujaa.
sw.R: Watakaobaki watakuwa wachache tu, lakini hao wachache wa jamaa ya Yakobo watamrudia Mungu Shujaa.

vi.L: Những người sót lại sẽ trở về, những người sót lại của Gia-cốp, \q về cùng Đức Chúa Trời quyền năng.
vi.B: Những người sót lại sẽ trở về, những người sót lại của Gia-cốp, \q trở về cùng Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng.
vi.R: Chỉ một số ít người sẽ còn lại, nhưng số ít người ấy trong dòng dõi Gia-cốp sẽ quay về với Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng.

decisions.choice: a remnant will return: the name of Isaiah's son Shear-jashub
decisions.reason: The two words are the name of the son Isaiah took with him to meet Ahaz (7:3). The name carried both a warning (only a remnant) and a promise (a remnant will return).

decisions.choice: return: come back to God, and come home
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn back. With "to the Mighty God" it means to turn back to God in repentance and trust (verse 20; 1:27; 6:10). It may also include coming home from exile.

decisions.choice: the Mighty God: the title of 9:5 (Hebrew numbering)
decisions.reason: The same two words are among the names of the child born for the throne of David in 9:5. Here they name the God to whom the remnant returns.

decisions.choice: Un remanente volverá ... al Dios Poderoso
decisions.reason: The first two words are the name Sear-jasub, explained at 7:3 R as "Un remanente volverá", so the same Spanish words are used here. "Dios Poderoso" is the L wording of the same title in 9:5.

decisions.choice: "Mungu Shujaa" as in 9:5
decisions.reason: The same title as the child's name in 9:5 (m3), so the echo is kept; "Mabaki watarudi" also repeats the meaning of Shear-yashubu given at 7:3.

decisions.choice: "Un reste reviendra ... au Dieu puissant"
decisions.reason: The first words are the name Shear-Yashouv, explained in 7:3 R as "Un reste reviendra"; "le Dieu puissant" keeps the wording of 9:5 L, as the terms note settles.

decisions.choice: "Những người sót lại sẽ trở về"
decisions.reason: The words are the meaning of the name Shear-jashub (7:3), and the B and R wording matches the meaning given there; "Đức Chúa Trời Quyền Năng" repeats the title of 9:5.

source.text: כִּ֣י אִם־יִהְיֶ֞ה עַמְּךָ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּלָּי֥וֹן חָר֖וּץ שׁוֹטֵ֥ף צְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For though will be your people, Israel, like [the] sand of the sea, a remnant will return in it; destruction [is] determined, overflowing [with] righteousness.

en.L: For though your people, Israel, be like the sand of the sea, \q a remnant within it will return; \q destruction [is] decreed, overflowing [with] righteousness.
en.B: Even if your people, Israel, are as many as the grains of sand by the sea, \q only a remnant within them will return. \q An end has been decided, and it comes flooding in with justice.
en.R: People of Israel, even if there are as many of you as there are grains of sand on the beach, \q only a few will come back. \q God has decided to destroy, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} judgment will sweep over the land like a flood. It will be completely fair.

es.L: Porque aunque tu pueblo, Israel, sea como la arena del mar, \q un remanente de él volverá; \q la destrucción [está] decretada, rebosante [de] justicia.
