es.B: Aunque tu pueblo, Israel, sea tan numeroso como los granos de arena del mar, \q solo un remanente de él volverá. \q Se ha decidido un fin, y llega como una inundación de justicia.
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, aunque seas tan numeroso como los granos de arena de la playa, \q solo unos pocos volverán. \q Dios ha decidido destruir, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} juicio inundará la tierra como un diluvio. Será completamente justo.

fr.L: Car même si ton peuple, Israël, était comme le sable de la mer, \q un reste en lui reviendra ; \q la destruction [est] décrétée, débordante de justice.
fr.B: Même si ton peuple, Israël, était aussi nombreux que les grains de sable de la mer, \q seul un reste reviendra. \q Une fin a été décidée, et elle arrive comme un flot, avec justice.
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, même si vous étiez aussi nombreux que les grains de sable sur la plage, \q seuls quelques-uns reviendront. \q Dieu a décidé de détruire, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} jugement va submerger le pays comme une inondation. Il sera parfaitement juste.

sw.L: Kwa maana ingawa watu wako, Israeli, watakuwa kama mchanga wa bahari, \q mabaki ndani yake watarudi; \q maangamizi [yameamriwa], yakifurika [kwa] haki.
sw.B: Hata kama watu wako, Israeli, ni wengi kama mchanga wa pwani, \q ni mabaki tu kati yao watakaorudi. \q Mwisho umekwisha kuamuliwa, nao unakuja ukifurika kwa haki.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Israeli, hata kama mtakuwa wengi kama chembe za mchanga pwani, \q ni wachache tu watakaorudi. \q Mungu ameamua kuangamiza, na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} itaifunika nchi kama gharika. Itakuwa ya haki kabisa.

vi.L: Vì dù dân ngươi, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, như cát biển, \q [chỉ] một số người sót lại trong đó sẽ trở về; \q sự hủy diệt đã được định, tràn ngập sự công chính.
vi.B: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù dân ngươi đông như cát bờ biển, \q chỉ một số người sót lại trong đó sẽ trở về. \q Sự tiêu diệt đã được định, tràn đến với công lý.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù các ngươi đông như cát trên bờ biển, \q chỉ một số ít sẽ trở về. \q Đức Chúa Trời đã quyết định hủy diệt, và sự phán xét của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tràn qua xứ như cơn lũ. Sự phán xét ấy hoàn toàn công bằng.

decisions.choice: like the sand of the sea: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: God promised Abraham descendants like the sand on the seashore (Genesis 22:17; 32:13). Even if that promise is kept in full, only a remnant will survive the judgment and return.

decisions.choice: a remnant will return: quoted in Romans 9:27-28
decisions.reason: Paul quotes verses 22-23 from the Greek Septuagint in Romans 9:27-28, to show that God saves a remnant of Israel by his grace.

decisions.choice: destruction decreed, overflowing with righteousness: a just judgment that sweeps over like a flood
decisions.reason: "Determined" means settled, cut and fixed. "Overflowing" pictures a flood (8:7-8; 28:15). "Righteousness" here is God's justice, the right he does in judging.

decisions.choice: only a remnant
decisions.reason: "Only" is implied by the contrast with the sand of the sea.

decisions.choice: justice
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered righteousness here means God's just judgment, so Balanced says "justice"; Literal keeps "righteousness".

decisions.choice: God has decided ... It will be completely fair.
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who decides and explains "righteousness" as a fair judgment.

decisions.choice: "comme le sable de la mer ... un reste"
decisions.reason: Romans 9:27 quotes the verse; the French keeps the key words of the published Romans 9:27 ("le sable de la mer", "le reste").

decisions.choice: "một số người sót lại ... sẽ trở về"
decisions.reason: The verse is quoted in Romans 9:27, which has "phần dân sót lại"; the Isaiah wording keeps the book's remnant word so that 10:20-22 read as one passage, and the verb "trở về" of the name.

source.text: כִּ֥י כָלָ֖ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֑ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת עֹשֶׂ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For complete destruction and [what is] determined [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts [is] making in [the] midst of all the land.

en.L: For a full end, and [one] decreed, \q the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts is making in the midst of all the land.
en.B: For the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies \q is about to bring a full and settled end within the whole land.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies has made up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind to bring this destruction on the whole land.

es.L: Porque una destrucción completa, y decretada, \q la está haciendo el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos en medio de toda la tierra.
es.B: Porque el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos \q está a punto de traer un fin completo y decidido sobre toda la tierra.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha decidido traer esta destrucción sobre todo el país.

fr.L: Car une destruction complète et décrétée, \q le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées l’exécute au milieu de tout le pays.
fr.B: Car le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées \q va accomplir dans tout le pays une fin complète et décidée.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées a décidé d’amener cette destruction sur tout le pays.

sw.L: Kwa maana ukomo kamili, nao [umeamriwa], \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi anaufanya katikati ya nchi yote.
sw.B: Kwa maana Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi \q yu karibu kuleta ukomo kamili na ulioamuliwa katika nchi yote.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameamua kuleta maangamizi haya juu ya nchi yote.

vi.L: Vì sự kết thúc trọn vẹn, đã được định, \q Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đang thực hiện giữa khắp xứ.
vi.B: Vì Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân \q sắp thực hiện sự kết thúc trọn vẹn đã định trên khắp xứ.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã quyết định giáng sự hủy diệt này trên khắp xứ.

decisions.choice: a full end, and one decreed: a phrase of final judgment
decisions.reason: The same pair of words appears in 28:22 and in Daniel 9:27. The end God has decided will certainly come.

decisions.choice: the land: the land of Israel, or the earth
decisions.reason: The word means land or earth. In context it most likely means the land of God's people; the Greek of Romans 9:28 has "on the earth".

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת אַל־תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔כָּה וּמַטֵּ֥הוּ יִשָּֽׂא־עָלֶ֖יךָ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh of hosts: do not be afraid, my people [who] dwell [in] Zion, of Assyria; with the rod he strikes you, and his staff he lifts against you in [the] way of Egypt.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts: \q Do not be afraid of Assyria, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who dwell [in] Zion; \q with the rod he strikes you, \q and his staff he lifts up against you in the way of Egypt.
en.B: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: \q Do not fear Assyria, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who live in Zion. \q He strikes you with the rod \q and raises his staff over you the way Egypt did.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: \q My people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians. \q They beat you with sticks and raise clubs against you, just as the Egyptians did long ago.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: \q No temas a Asiria, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} que habitas [en] Sion; \q con la vara te golpea, \q y su bastón levanta contra ti a la manera de Egipto.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: \q No tengas miedo de Asiria, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} que vives en Sion. \q Te golpea con la vara \q y levanta su bastón contra ti, como lo hizo Egipto.
es.R: Por eso esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: \q Pueblo mío que vives en Sion, no tengas miedo de los asirios. \q Te golpean con palos y levantan garrotes contra ti, así como lo hicieron los egipcios hace mucho tiempo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Ne crains pas l’Assyrie, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple qui habites Sion ; \q avec la verge il te frappe, \q et il lève son bâton contre toi à la manière de l’Égypte.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : \q Ne crains pas l’Assyrie, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple qui habites Sion. \q Elle te frappe avec la verge \q et lève son bâton sur toi comme l’a fait l’Égypte.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées : \q Mon peuple qui habites à Sion, n’aie pas peur des Assyriens. \q Ils te frappent avec des bâtons et lèvent leurs gourdins contre toi, comme l’ont fait autrefois les Égyptiens.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: \q Msimwogope Ashuru, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mkaao [katika] Sayuni; \q anawapiga kwa fimbo, \q na anainua gongo lake juu yenu kwa njia ya Misri.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: \q Msimwogope Ashuru, enyi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mnaoishi Sayuni. \q Anawapiga kwa fimbo \q na kuinua gongo lake juu yenu kama Misri ilivyofanya.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: \q Enyi watu wangu mnaoishi Sayuni, msiwaogope Waashuru. \q Wanawapiga kwa fimbo na kuinua marungu dhidi yenu, kama Wamisri walivyofanya zamani.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: \q Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở Si-ôn, đừng sợ A-si-ri; \q nó dùng roi đánh ngươi, \q và giơ gậy lên nghịch ngươi như Ai Cập đã làm.
vi.B: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: \q Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sống ở Si-ôn, con đừng sợ A-si-ri. \q Nó dùng roi đánh con \q và giơ gậy lên trên con như Ai Cập đã làm.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: \q Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sống ở Si-ôn, con đừng sợ quân A-si-ri. \q Chúng dùng gậy đánh con và giơ roi lên nghịch con, như người Ai Cập đã làm thuở xưa.

decisions.choice: in the way of Egypt: as Egypt oppressed Israel
decisions.reason: Assyria treats God's people as Egypt did when Israel was enslaved there (Exodus 1-5). In verse 26 the same phrase turns: God will lift his staff as he did in Egypt, when he set his people free.

decisions.choice: do not be afraid, my people: comfort after judgment
decisions.reason: The judgment of verses 5-23 is real, but God still calls Zion "my people". Assyria's blows will soon end (verse 25).

decisions.choice: the Assyrians ... the Egyptians did long ago
decisions.reason: Readable names the peoples and explains that Egypt's oppression was long past.

decisions.choice: "tu"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses "my people" in the singular here ("you" and "your" are singular), so French says "tu", as the terms note settles.

decisions.choice: God says "con" to his people at B and R in this word of comfort
decisions.reason: The terms note: Zion addressed as one person in comfort is "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R); the Hebrew here says "you" in the singular, and verses 24-27 are a promise, unlike the rebukes of 1:21-26 and 3:12.

source.text: כִּי־ע֖וֹד מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֑ר וְכָ֣לָה זַ֔עַם וְאַפִּ֖י עַל־תַּבְלִיתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For yet a little, a little, and will be finished [the] indignation, and my anger [will be] on their destruction.

en.L: For yet a very little [while], \q and [the] indignation will be finished, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger [will turn] to their destruction.
en.B: For only a little while longer, \q and the fury will be spent; \q then {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will turn to their ruin.
en.R: Very soon I will stop being angry with you. \q Then {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will turn against the Assyrians, and I will destroy them.

es.L: Porque dentro de muy poco [tiempo], \q se acabará la indignación, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira [se volverá] para su destrucción.
es.B: Porque dentro de muy poco tiempo \q el furor se habrá agotado; \q entonces {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira se volverá para su ruina.
es.R: Muy pronto dejaré de estar enojado contigo. \q Entonces {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira se volverá contra los asirios, y los destruiré.

fr.L: Car encore un peu, très peu [de temps], \q et l’indignation prendra fin, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère [se tournera] vers leur destruction.
fr.B: Car encore très peu de temps, \q et la fureur sera passée ; \q alors {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère se tournera vers leur ruine.
fr.R: Très bientôt, je ne serai plus en colère contre toi. \q Alors {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère se tournera contre les Assyriens, et je les détruirai.

sw.L: Kwa maana bado kitambo kidogo sana, \q na ghadhabu itakwisha, \q na hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} [itageuka] kwa maangamizi yao.
sw.B: Kwa maana bado kitambo kidogo tu, \q na ghadhabu itakuwa imekwisha; \q kisha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itageuka kuwaangamiza wao.
sw.R: Hivi karibuni nitaacha kuwakasirikia. \q Kisha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itageuka dhidi ya Waashuru, nami nitawaangamiza.

vi.L: Vì chỉ còn một chút nữa thôi, \q cơn phẫn nộ sẽ chấm dứt, \q và cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [sẽ quay sang] hủy diệt chúng.
vi.B: Vì chỉ còn ít lâu nữa thôi, \q cơn phẫn nộ sẽ qua đi; \q rồi cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quay sang tiêu diệt chúng.
vi.R: Chẳng bao lâu nữa Ta sẽ thôi giận con. \q Rồi cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quay sang quân A-si-ri, và Ta sẽ tiêu diệt chúng.

decisions.choice: a little, a little: a very short time
decisions.reason: The repeated word stresses how short the time will be (16:14; 29:17).

decisions.choice: the indignation ... their destruction: God's anger moves from his people to Assyria
decisions.reason: The indignation against God's people will come to an end (verse 5 used the same word). "Their" is the Assyrians: God's anger will be turned to destroying them.

decisions.choice: with you ... against the Assyrians
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the anger was against and whom it will now be against.

source.text: וְעוֹרֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שׁ֔וֹט כְּמַכַּ֥ת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּצ֣וּר עוֹרֵ֑ב וּמַטֵּ֨הוּ֙ עַל־הַיָּ֔ם וּנְשָׂא֖וֹ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will wield against him Yahweh of hosts a whip, like [the] striking of Midian at [the] rock of Oreb; and his staff [is] over the sea, and he will lift it in [the] way of Egypt.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts will wield a whip against him, \q like the striking of Midian at the rock of Oreb; \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} staff [will be] over the sea, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will lift it up in the way of Egypt.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will crack a whip over him, \q as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. \q His staff will be over the sea, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will lift it up as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did in Egypt.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will attack the Assyrians with a whip. \q It will be like the time Gideon defeated the Midianites at the rock of Oreb. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will hold {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} staff out over the sea, \q the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did in Egypt long ago.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos levantará un látigo contra él, \q como la matanza de Madián en la peña de Oreb; \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} vara [estará] sobre el mar, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la alzará a la manera de Egipto.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos hará restallar un látigo sobre él, \q como en la matanza de Madián en la peña de Oreb. \q Su vara estará sobre el mar, \q y la levantará como lo hizo en Egipto.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos atacará a los asirios con un látigo. \q Será como la vez en que Gedeón derrotó a los madianitas en la peña de Oreb. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} extenderá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} vara sobre el mar, \q como lo hizo en Egipto hace mucho tiempo.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées agitera contre lui un fouet, \q comme lorsqu’il frappa Madiân au rocher d’Oreb ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bâton [sera] sur la mer, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lèvera à la manière de l’Égypte.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées fera claquer le fouet sur lui, \q comme lors du massacre de Madiân au rocher d’Oreb. \q Son bâton sera sur la mer, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le lèvera comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait en Égypte.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées attaquera les Assyriens avec un fouet. \q Ce sera comme le jour où Gédéon a vaincu les Madianites au rocher d’Oreb. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bâton au-dessus de la mer, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait autrefois en Égypte.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atampigia mjeledi, \q kama mapigo ya Midiani penye mwamba wa Orebu; \q na fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [itakuwa] juu ya bahari, \q naye ataiinua kwa njia ya Misri.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atampigia mjeledi, \q kama alivyowachinja Wamidiani penye mwamba wa Orebu. \q Fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} itakuwa juu ya bahari, \q naye ataiinua kama alivyofanya Misri.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atawashambulia Waashuru kwa mjeledi. \q Itakuwa kama wakati ule Gideoni alipowashinda Wamidiani penye mwamba wa Orebu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atanyosha fimbo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} juu ya bahari, \q kama alivyofanya Misri zamani.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ vung roi nghịch lại nó, \q như khi đánh Ma-đi-an tại tảng đá Ô-rép; \q và gậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [sẽ giơ] trên biển, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giơ nó lên như tại Ai Cập.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ quất roi trên nó, \q như trong cuộc tàn sát Ma-đi-an tại tảng đá Ô-rép. \q Gậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giơ trên biển, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giơ nó lên như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm tại Ai Cập.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ dùng roi tấn công quân A-si-ri. \q Điều ấy sẽ như khi Ghê-đê-ôn đánh bại quân Ma-đi-an tại tảng đá Ô-rép. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giơ gậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trên biển, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm tại Ai Cập thuở xưa.

decisions.choice: the striking of Midian at the rock of Oreb: Gideon's victory
decisions.reason: In Judges 7:25 the Midianite leader Oreb was killed at a rock that took his name, when God gave Gideon victory over a great army with a few men. Isaiah recalled the same day of Midian in 9:3 (Hebrew numbering).

decisions.choice: his staff over the sea ... in the way of Egypt: the crossing of the Red Sea
decisions.reason: At the sea Moses lifted his staff over the water at God's command, and Egypt's army was drowned (Exodus 14:16, 26-27). "In the way of Egypt" in verse 24 meant the way Egypt oppressed; here it means the way God rescued his people from Egypt.

decisions.choice: as he did in Egypt
decisions.reason: "In the way of Egypt" here refers to what God did there, so Balanced supplies "as he did".

decisions.choice: the Assyrians ... Gideon
decisions.reason: Readable names "him" as the Assyrians and names Gideon, the leader in Judges 7.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָס֤וּר סֻבֳּלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔ךָ וְעֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֑ךָ וְחֻבַּ֥ל עֹ֖ל מִפְּנֵי־שָֽׁמֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in day the that, will be removed his burden from on your shoulder, and his yoke from on your neck, and will be broken [the] yoke because of fatness.

en.L: And it will be in that day, his burden will be removed from your shoulder \q and his yoke from your neck, \q and [the] yoke will be broken because of fatness.
en.B: On that day the load he laid on your shoulder will be taken away, \q and his yoke off your neck. \q The yoke will snap because of fatness.
en.R: At that time, Assyria's heavy load will be taken off your shoulders. \q The yoke Assyria put on your neck will be taken away. \q The yoke will break, like a yoke that breaks when the ox grows too big and strong for it.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día que su carga será quitada de tu hombro \q y su yugo de tu cuello, \q y el yugo será roto a causa de la gordura.
es.B: Aquel día la carga que él puso sobre tu hombro te será quitada, \q y su yugo de encima de tu cuello. \q El yugo se romperá a causa de la gordura.
es.R: En ese tiempo te quitarán de los hombros la carga pesada de Asiria. \q Te quitarán del cuello el yugo que Asiria te puso. \q El yugo se romperá, como un yugo que se rompe cuando el buey crece demasiado grande y fuerte para él.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là que son fardeau sera ôté de dessus ton épaule, \q et son joug de dessus ton cou, \q et le joug sera brisé à cause de la graisse.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, la charge qu’il a mise sur ton épaule te sera enlevée, \q et son joug ôté de ton cou. \q Le joug se brisera à cause de la graisse.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, la lourde charge de l’Assyrie sera enlevée de tes épaules. \q Le joug que l’Assyrie a mis sur ton cou sera ôté. \q Le joug se cassera, comme un joug qui casse quand le bœuf devient trop gros et trop fort pour lui.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, mzigo wake utaondolewa begani mwako \q na nira yake shingoni mwako, \q na nira itavunjwa kwa sababu ya unono.
sw.B: Siku hiyo mzigo alioweka begani mwako utaondolewa, \q na nira yake shingoni mwako. \q Nira itavunjika kwa sababu ya unono.
sw.R: Wakati huo mzigo mzito wa Ashuru utaondolewa mabegani mwenu. \q Nira ambayo Ashuru aliiweka shingoni mwenu itaondolewa. \q Nira itavunjika, kama nira inavyovunjika ng'ombe anapokua mkubwa na mwenye nguvu kuliko nira hiyo.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, gánh nặng của nó sẽ được cất khỏi vai ngươi, \q ách của nó khỏi cổ ngươi, \q và cái ách sẽ bị gãy vì sự béo mập.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, gánh nặng nó đặt trên vai con sẽ được cất đi, \q và ách của nó sẽ được tháo khỏi cổ con. \q Cái ách sẽ gãy vì sự béo mập.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, gánh nặng của A-si-ri sẽ được cất khỏi vai con. \q Cái ách A-si-ri đặt trên cổ con sẽ được tháo đi. \q Cái ách sẽ gãy, như ách bị gãy khi con bò lớn lên quá to khỏe.

decisions.choice: his burden ... his yoke: Assyria's rule lifted
decisions.reason: "His" is Assyria. The same picture of a broken yoke and a lifted burden is in 9:3 (Hebrew numbering) and 14:25.

decisions.choice: because of fatness: the yoke breaks because the neck has grown strong
alternatives: the start of the march in verse 28
decisions.reason: The words are hard. They most likely mean that the ox has grown so fat and strong that its yoke breaks. The word can also mean oil, and some read it as "because of the anointing". Others take the last word with the march of verse 28, as a place from which the enemy comes up.

decisions.choice: like a yoke that breaks when the ox grows too big and strong for it
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the most likely sense of "fatness".

source.text: בָּ֥א עַל־עַיַּ֖ת עָבַ֣ר בְּמִגְר֑וֹן לְמִכְמָ֖שׂ יַפְקִ֥יד כֵּלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: He has come to Aiath; he has passed through Migron; at Michmash he deposits his baggage.

en.L: He has come to Aiath; he has passed through Migron; \q at Michmash he deposits his baggage.
en.B: He has reached Aiath and marched through Migron; \q at Michmash he leaves his baggage.
en.R: The enemy army has reached the town of Aiath. It has gone through Migron. \q At Michmash the soldiers leave their heavy supplies.

es.L: Ha llegado a Ayat; ha pasado por Migrón; \q en Micmas deja su bagaje.
es.B: Ha llegado a Ayat y ha atravesado Migrón; \q en Micmas deja su equipaje.
es.R: El ejército enemigo ha llegado al pueblo de Ayat. Ha pasado por Migrón. \q En Micmas los soldados dejan sus provisiones pesadas.

fr.L: Il est venu à Aïath ; il a traversé Migrôn ; \q à Mikmash il dépose son bagage.
fr.B: Il a atteint Aïath et traversé Migrôn ; \q à Mikmash il laisse ses bagages.
fr.R: L’armée ennemie est arrivée à la ville d’Aïath. Elle a traversé Migrôn. \q À Mikmash, les soldats laissent leur matériel lourd.

sw.L: Amefika Ayathi; amepita katikati ya Migroni; \q huko Mikmashi anaweka mizigo yake.
sw.B: Amefika Ayathi na kupita Migroni; \q huko Mikmashi anaacha mizigo yake.
sw.R: Jeshi la adui limefika katika mji wa Ayathi. Limepita Migroni. \q Huko Mikmashi askari wanaacha mizigo yao mizito.

vi.L: Nó đã đến A-giát; nó đã đi qua Mi-gơ-rôn; \q tại Mích-ma nó để lại hành trang mình.
vi.B: Nó đã đến A-giát và băng qua Mi-gơ-rôn; \q tại Mích-ma nó để lại đồ quân trang.
vi.R: Quân thù đã đến thành A-giát. Chúng đã đi qua Mi-gơ-rôn. \q Tại Mích-ma, binh lính để lại đồ tiếp tế nặng nề.

decisions.choice: Aiath, Migron, Michmash: towns north of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Verses 28-32 picture an enemy marching south toward Jerusalem from town to town, each closer than the last. Aiath is Ai (Joshua 7-8; Nehemiah 11:31); Michmash is where Jonathan fought the Philistines (1 Samuel 13-14). The march ends within sight of the city (verse 32).

decisions.choice: he has come: the enemy is not named
decisions.reason: The verbs are vivid, as though the prophet sees the march happening. The one marching is not named, but in context it is the Assyrian king of verses 5-15.

decisions.choice: deposits his baggage: leaves the heavy supplies behind
decisions.reason: An army left its heavy gear in a camp before moving fast against a city (1 Samuel 17:22).

decisions.choice: The enemy army
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject the Hebrew leaves unnamed, without saying which army it is.

decisions.choice: "Aïath, Migrôn, Mikmash"
decisions.reason: The towns keep the published French forms of Samuel (Migrôn, Mikmash); Aïath, otherwise unknown in the French drafts, follows the same spelling.

decisions.choice: "A-giát", "Mi-gơ-rôn" (new); "Mích-ma" as 1 Samuel 13:2
decisions.reason: The towns on the enemy's route to Jerusalem (verses 28-32) are transliterated; those already published keep their forms: Mích-ma, Ghê-ba, Ra-ma, Ghi-bê-a, Ga-lim, A-na-tốt, Nóp. New: La-i-sa, Mát-mê-na, Ghê-bim.

source.text: עָֽבְרוּ֙ מַעְבָּרָ֔ה גֶּ֖בַע מָל֣וֹן לָ֑נוּ חָֽרְדָה֙ הָֽרָמָ֔ה גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל נָֽסָה׃

records.literal_gloss: They have crossed the pass; Geba [is] a lodging for us; Ramah has trembled; Gibeah of Saul has fled.

en.L: They have crossed the pass: \q "Geba [is] a lodging for us!" \q Ramah trembles; \q Gibeah of Saul has fled.
en.B: They have gone across the pass: \q "Geba will be our camp for the night!" \q Ramah is trembling; \q Gibeah of Saul has taken flight.
en.R: The soldiers have crossed the narrow pass. \q They say, "We will camp tonight at Geba!" \q The people of Ramah are shaking with fear. \q The people of Gibeah, King Saul's hometown, have run away.

es.L: Han cruzado el paso: \q «¡Geba [es] alojamiento para nosotros!». \q Ramá tiembla; \q Guibeá de Saúl ha huido.
es.B: Han atravesado el desfiladero: \q «¡Geba será nuestro campamento esta noche!». \q Ramá está temblando; \q Guibeá de Saúl ha emprendido la huida.
es.R: Los soldados han cruzado el paso estrecho. \q Dicen: «¡Esta noche acamparemos en Geba!». \q La gente de Ramá tiembla de miedo. \q La gente de Guibeá, el pueblo del rey Saúl, ha huido.

fr.L: Ils ont franchi le passage : \q « Guéba [est] un gîte pour nous ! » \q Rama tremble ; \q Guibea de Saül s’est enfuie.
fr.B: Ils ont passé le défilé : \q « Guéba sera notre campement pour la nuit ! » \q Rama tremble ; \q Guibea de Saül a pris la fuite.
fr.R: Les soldats ont traversé le passage étroit. \q Ils disent : « Ce soir, nous camperons à Guéba ! » \q Les gens de Rama tremblent de peur. \q Les gens de Guibea, la ville du roi Saül, se sont enfuis.

sw.L: Wamevuka njia nyembamba: \q "Geba [ni] mahali petu pa kulala!" \q Rama inatetemeka; \q Gibea ya Sauli imekimbia.
sw.B: Wamevuka njia nyembamba ya milimani: \q "Geba patakuwa kambi yetu ya usiku!" \q Rama inatetemeka; \q Gibea ya Sauli imekimbia.
sw.R: Askari wamevuka njia nyembamba kati ya milima. \q Wanasema, "Tutapiga kambi usiku huu huko Geba!" \q Watu wa Rama wanatetemeka kwa hofu. \q Watu wa Gibea, mji wa mfalme Sauli, wamekimbia.

vi.L: Chúng đã vượt qua đèo: \q "Ghê-ba [là] chỗ nghỉ đêm của chúng ta!" \q Ra-ma run rẩy; \q Ghi-bê-a của Sau-lơ đã bỏ chạy.
vi.B: Chúng đã băng qua đèo: \q "Ghê-ba sẽ là trại nghỉ đêm của chúng ta!" \q Ra-ma run sợ; \q Ghi-bê-a của Sau-lơ đã chạy trốn.
vi.R: Binh lính đã vượt qua đèo hẹp. \q Chúng nói: "Đêm nay chúng ta sẽ đóng trại tại Ghê-ba!" \q Dân thành Ra-ma run sợ. \q Dân Ghi-bê-a, quê hương của vua Sau-lơ, đã bỏ chạy.

decisions.choice: the pass, Geba: the gorge between Michmash and Geba
decisions.reason: A deep, narrow valley separates Michmash from Geba (1 Samuel 13:23; 14:4-5). Crossing it brought the army into Judah's own land.

decisions.choice: Geba is a lodging for us: the soldiers' words
decisions.reason: The words are spoken by the army: they will spend the night at Geba. They may also be read as a statement, "they lodged at Geba".

decisions.choice: Ramah, Gibeah of Saul
decisions.reason: Ramah was Samuel's town (1 Samuel 7:17); Gibeah was Saul's home and royal seat (1 Samuel 10:26). Both were a few miles north of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: The people of Ramah ... King Saul's hometown
decisions.reason: Readable says that the towns stand for their people and explains Gibeah of Saul.

source.text: צַהֲלִ֥י קוֹלֵ֖ךְ בַּת־גַּלִּ֑ים הַקְשִׁ֥יבִי לַ֖יְשָׁה עֲנִיָּ֥ה עֲנָתֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Cry aloud [with] your voice, daughter of Gallim! Pay attention, Laishah! Afflicted [one], Anathoth!

en.L: Cry shrill [with] your voice, daughter of Gallim! \q Pay attention, Laishah! Afflicted [one], Anathoth!
en.B: Raise your voice and cry, Daughter Gallim! \q Take heed, Laishah! Afflicted Anathoth!
en.R: People of Gallim, scream for help! \q People of Laishah, listen! Poor people of Anathoth!

es.L: ¡Grita con tu voz, hija de Galim! \q ¡Presta atención, Laisa! ¡Pobre Anatot!
es.B: ¡Levanta la voz y grita, hija de Galim! \q ¡Pon atención, Laisa! ¡Pobre Anatot!
es.R: ¡Gente de Galim, {{plural_you:griten|gritad}} pidiendo ayuda! \q ¡Gente de Laisa, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}}! ¡Pobre gente de Anatot!

fr.L: Fais retentir ta voix, fille de Gallim ! \q Sois attentive, Laïsha ! Malheureuse Anatoth !
fr.B: Élève la voix et crie, fille de Gallim ! \q Prends garde, Laïsha ! Pauvre Anatoth !
fr.R: Habitants de Gallim, criez au secours ! \q Habitants de Laïsha, écoutez ! Pauvres habitants d’Anatoth !

sw.L: Piga kelele [kwa] sauti yako, binti Galimu! \q Sikiliza, Laisha! Ewe mnyonge, Anathothi!
sw.B: Paza sauti yako ulie, Binti Galimu! \q Sikiliza, Laisha! Anathothi mnyonge!
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Galimu, pigeni kelele mwombe msaada! \q Enyi watu wa Laisha, sikilizeni! Maskini watu wa Anathothi!

vi.L: Hãy cất tiếng kêu la, hỡi con gái Ga-lim! \q Hãy lắng nghe, hỡi La-i-sa! Khốn khổ thay, A-na-tốt!
vi.B: Hãy cất tiếng kêu khóc, hỡi con gái Ga-lim! \q Hãy chú ý, hỡi La-i-sa! Hỡi A-na-tốt khốn khổ!
vi.R: Hỡi dân Ga-lim, hãy la lên cầu cứu! \q Hỡi dân La-i-sa, hãy lắng nghe! Hỡi dân A-na-tốt đáng thương!

decisions.choice: daughter of Gallim: the town of Gallim and its people
decisions.reason: As in "daughter Zion", "daughter" names a town as a woman, and so its people (1:8).

decisions.choice: afflicted, Anathoth: poor Anathoth
decisions.reason: The word means afflicted or wretched and sounds like the town's name, Anathoth, the home of the priest Abiathar and of Jeremiah (1 Kings 2:26; Jeremiah 1:1). With a change of vowels it can be read "answer her, Anathoth", one town echoing another's cry.

decisions.choice: People of Gallim ... People of Laishah ... Poor people of Anathoth
decisions.reason: Readable names the people of each town.

source.text: נָדְדָ֖ה מַדְמֵנָ֑ה יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַגֵּבִ֖ים הֵעִֽיזוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Has fled Madmenah; [the] inhabitants of Gebim have brought to safety.

en.L: Madmenah has fled; \q the inhabitants of Gebim have brought [their goods] to safety.
en.B: Madmenah has run away; \q those who live in Gebim have hurried their goods to safety.
en.R: The people of Madmenah have run away. \q The people of Gebim have taken their things and hurried to a safe place.

es.L: Madmena ha huido; \q los habitantes de Gebim han puesto a salvo [sus bienes].
es.B: Madmena ha escapado; \q los que viven en Gebim han puesto a salvo sus bienes a toda prisa.
es.R: La gente de Madmena ha huido. \q La gente de Gebim ha tomado sus cosas y se ha apresurado a ir a un lugar seguro.

fr.L: Madména s’est enfuie ; \q les habitants de Guébim ont mis [leurs biens] à l’abri.
fr.B: Madména a pris la fuite ; \q les habitants de Guébim mettent en hâte leurs biens à l’abri.
fr.R: Les gens de Madména se sont enfuis. \q Les gens de Guébim ont pris leurs affaires et se sont dépêchés de se mettre à l’abri.

sw.L: Madmena imekimbia; \q wakaaji wa Gebimu wamekimbilia usalama.
sw.B: Madmena imetoroka; \q wakazi wa Gebimu wamebeba mali zao wakakimbilia usalama.
sw.R: Watu wa Madmena wamekimbia. \q Watu wa Gebimu wamechukua vitu vyao na kuharakisha kwenda mahali salama.

vi.L: Mát-mê-na đã trốn chạy; \q cư dân Ghê-bim đã đem [của cải] đi lánh nạn.
vi.B: Mát-mê-na đã bỏ chạy; \q dân cư Ghê-bim vội vàng đem của cải đi lánh nạn.
vi.R: Dân Mát-mê-na đã bỏ chạy. \q Dân Ghê-bim đã gom đồ đạc và vội vã chạy đến nơi an toàn.

decisions.choice: have brought to safety: carried off their goods, taken refuge
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring something into a safe place (Exodus 9:19; Jeremiah 4:6). The people of Gebim gather what they can and flee.

decisions.choice: Madmenah, Gebim: small towns near Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Their exact places are not known; they lay on the way to Jerusalem from the north.

source.text: ע֥וֹד הַיּ֖וֹם בְּנֹ֣ב לַֽעֲמֹ֑ד יְנֹפֵ֤ף יָדוֹ֙ הַ֣ר בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן גִּבְעַ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Yet the day at Nob to stand; he will shake his hand [at the] mountain of [the] daughter of Zion, [the] hill of Jerusalem.

en.L: Yet this day [he is] at Nob to stand; \q he will shake his hand [at the] mountain of the daughter of Zion, \q the hill of Jerusalem.
en.B: Before this day is over he will stand at Nob, \q waving his fist toward the mountain of Daughter Zion, \q toward Jerusalem's hill.
en.R: This very day the enemy will stop at the town of Nob. \q From there he will shake his fist at Mount Zion, \q the hill where Jerusalem stands.

es.L: Todavía hoy [estará] en Nob para detenerse; \q agitará su mano [contra] el monte de la hija de Sion, \q la colina de Jerusalén.
es.B: Antes de que termine este día se detendrá en Nob, \q agitando el puño hacia el monte de la hija de Sion, \q hacia la colina de Jerusalén.
es.R: Hoy mismo el enemigo se detendrá en el pueblo de Nob. \q Desde allí sacudirá el puño contra el monte Sion, \q la colina donde está Jerusalén.

fr.L: Encore ce jour-là, [il fera] halte à Nob ; \q il agitera sa main [contre] la montagne de la fille de Sion, \q la colline de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Avant la fin du jour, il s’arrêtera à Nob, \q et il agitera le poing vers la montagne de la fille de Sion, \q vers la colline de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Aujourd’hui même, l’ennemi s’arrêtera à la ville de Nob. \q De là, il montrera le poing au mont Sion, \q la colline où se trouve Jérusalem.

sw.L: Leo hii bado [atakuwa] Nobu kusimama; \q atatikisa mkono wake [juu ya] mlima wa binti Sayuni, \q kilima cha Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kabla siku hii haijaisha atasimama Nobu, \q akiutikisa ngumi kuelekea mlima wa Binti Sayuni, \q kuelekea kilima cha Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Siku hii hii adui atasimama katika mji wa Nobu. \q Kutoka huko atautikisia ngumi mlima Sayuni, \q kilima ambapo Yerusalemu umesimama.

vi.L: Ngay hôm nay [nó sẽ] dừng lại tại Nóp; \q nó sẽ vung tay [nghịch] núi của con gái Si-ôn, \q đồi của Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Trước khi ngày nay qua đi, nó sẽ đứng tại Nóp, \q vung nắm đấm về phía núi của con gái Si-ôn, \q về phía đồi Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ngay hôm nay quân thù sẽ dừng lại tại thành Nóp. \q Từ đó hắn sẽ giơ nắm đấm đe dọa núi Si-ôn, \q ngọn đồi nơi thành Giê-ru-sa-lem tọa lạc.

decisions.choice: Nob: the last stop, close to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Nob was a town of priests (1 Samuel 21-22) close to Jerusalem on the north (Nehemiah 11:32). From there the enemy can see the city.

decisions.choice: shake his hand: threaten
decisions.reason: Shaking one's hand at a city is a gesture of threat and scorn. The march stops here: the next verse tells what God does.

decisions.choice: daughter of Zion: the reading of the margin
decisions.reason: The written text has "house of Zion"; the reading in the margin has "daughter of Zion", the phrase Isaiah uses elsewhere (1:8; 16:1, where the same line returns).

decisions.choice: Mount Zion
decisions.reason: Readable says "Mount Zion" for "the mountain of the daughter of Zion".

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה הָאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְסָעֵ֥ף פֻּארָ֖ה בְּמַעֲרָצָ֑ה וְרָמֵ֤י הַקּוֹמָה֙ גְּדוּעִ֔ים וְהַגְּבֹהִ֖ים יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, the Lord, Yahweh of hosts, [is] lopping off boughs with a terrifying crash, and the exalted ones of height [are] cut down, and the high ones will be brought low.

en.L: Look, the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] lopping off boughs with a terrifying crash; \q and the high [ones] of stature [are] cut down, \q and the lofty will be brought low.
en.B: Look! The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies is about to strip away the boughs with a terrifying crash. \q The trees that tower highest will be cut down; \q the proud heights will be laid low.
en.R: But look! The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies is ready to chop off the branches with a terrible crash. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will cut down the tallest trees, those proud and powerful enemies, and bring them down low.

es.L: He aquí, el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos desgaja las ramas con estruendo terrible; \q y los de gran altura [son] cortados, \q y los elevados serán abatidos.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos está a punto de arrancar las ramas con un estruendo aterrador. \q Los árboles más altos serán talados; \q las alturas orgullosas serán derribadas.
es.R: ¡Pero {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}! El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos está listo para cortar las ramas con un estruendo terrible. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cortará los árboles más altos, esos enemigos orgullosos y poderosos, y los derribará.

fr.L: Voici, le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées abat les branches avec un fracas terrifiant ; \q et les hauts de taille [sont] coupés, \q et les élevés seront abaissés.
fr.B: Voici ! Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées va arracher les branches avec un fracas terrifiant. \q Les arbres les plus hauts seront abattus ; \q les cimes orgueilleuses seront abaissées.
fr.R: Mais regardez ! Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées est prêt à couper les branches avec un bruit terrible. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} abattra les arbres les plus hauts, ces ennemis orgueilleux et puissants, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les fera tomber bien bas.

sw.L: Tazama, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [anayakata] matawi kwa kishindo cha kutisha; \q na walio juu kwa kimo [wanakatwa], \q na walioinuka watashushwa.
sw.B: Tazama! Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi yu karibu kuyapogoa matawi kwa kishindo cha kutisha. \q Miti mirefu kuliko yote itakatwa; \q vilele vya kiburi vitashushwa chini.
sw.R: Lakini tazama! Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi yuko tayari kukata matawi kwa kishindo kikubwa. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataikata miti mirefu kuliko yote, yaani, maadui wale wenye kiburi na nguvu, na kuwashusha chini.

vi.L: Kìa, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đang chặt các cành cây với một tiếng đổ kinh hoàng; \q những cây cao lớn bị đốn xuống, \q và những cây cao ngất sẽ bị hạ thấp.
vi.B: Kìa! Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sắp tỉa sạch cành lá với một tiếng đổ rầm kinh hãi. \q Những cây cao nhất sẽ bị đốn ngã; \q những ngọn cao ngạo nghễ sẽ bị hạ xuống.
vi.R: Nhưng hãy xem! Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẵn sàng chặt các cành cây với một tiếng đổ rầm khủng khiếp. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đốn những cây cao nhất, tức là những kẻ thù kiêu ngạo và hùng mạnh, và hạ chúng xuống thấp.

decisions.choice: look, the Lord: God acts at the last moment
decisions.reason: At the very point where the enemy shakes his fist at Jerusalem (verse 32), God acts. In 701 BC the Assyrian army of Sennacherib withdrew from Jerusalem without taking it (37:36-37).

decisions.choice: the high ones brought low: God humbles the proud
decisions.reason: The words echo 2:12-17, where all that is high and lifted up, the cedars of Lebanon among them, is brought low on the LORD's day. Here the tall trees are the Assyrian king and his army (verses 12, 18).

decisions.choice: a terrifying crash: terror, a dreadful sound
decisions.reason: The rare word means a frightening thing; with the lopping of branches it pictures the crash of falling boughs.

decisions.choice: those proud and powerful enemies
decisions.reason: Readable says that the trees stand for the enemy.

source.text: וְנִקַּ֛ף סִֽבְכֵ֥י הַיַּ֖עַר בַּבַּרְזֶ֑ל וְהַלְּבָנ֖וֹן בְּאַדִּ֥יר יִפּֽוֹל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he will cut down [the] thickets of the forest with the iron, and the Lebanon by a mighty one will fall.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, \q and Lebanon will fall by a mighty one.
en.B: He will hack down the tangled forest with iron, \q and Lebanon will come crashing down by a mighty one.
en.R: He will cut down the thick forest with an iron ax. \q Even Lebanon, with its great trees, will fall to someone mighty.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cortará la espesura del bosque con el hierro, \q y el Líbano caerá por un poderoso.
es.B: Talará con el hierro la espesura del bosque, \q y el Líbano se vendrá abajo por mano de un poderoso.
es.R: Cortará el bosque espeso con un hacha de hierro. \q Hasta el Líbano, con sus grandes árboles, caerá ante alguien poderoso.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} abattra les fourrés de la forêt avec le fer, \q et le Liban tombera par un puissant.
fr.B: Il taillera dans les fourrés de la forêt avec le fer, \q et le Liban s’écroulera sous les coups d’un puissant.
fr.R: Il abattra l’épaisse forêt avec une hache en fer. \q Même le Liban, avec ses grands arbres, tombera devant quelqu’un de puissant.

sw.L: Naye atavikata vichaka vya msitu kwa chuma, \q na Lebanoni itaanguka kwa mwenye nguvu.
sw.B: Atakikatakata kichaka cha msitu kwa chuma, \q na Lebanoni itaanguka kwa kishindo kwa mkono wa mwenye nguvu.
sw.R: Atakata msitu mnene kwa shoka la chuma. \q Hata Lebanoni, pamoja na miti yake mikubwa, itaangushwa na mwenye nguvu.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ dùng sắt chặt các bụi rậm trong rừng, \q và Li-ban sẽ ngã bởi một đấng quyền năng.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ dùng rìu sắt phát quang cả khu rừng rậm, \q và Li-ban sẽ đổ ầm xuống bởi tay một đấng quyền năng.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ dùng rìu sắt chặt khu rừng rậm. \q Ngay cả Li-ban với những cây lớn cũng sẽ ngã trước một đấng quyền năng.

decisions.choice: the forest, Lebanon: the might of Assyria
decisions.reason: Lebanon was famous for its great cedars (2:13; 37:24). Here the forest stands for Assyria's army and power, felled like trees. In 11:1 a new shoot will grow from the stump of Jesse: the forest of Assyria is cut down for good, but the house of David will sprout again.

decisions.choice: a mighty one: God, or a mighty ax
decisions.reason: The word means majestic or mighty. It most likely points to God himself, the Majestic One (33:21). It may also describe the iron tool that fells the trees.

decisions.choice: he will cut down: the Lord of verse 33
alternatives: the thickets of the forest will be cut down
decisions.reason: The subject is the Lord who lops the boughs in verse 33. The verb can also be read as passive, "the thickets will be cut down".
